title: YouTube Video Editor For Documentary Channel
description:
Full-time · Salary: $650 - $850+ USD/month · Hours: 40/week



We're a YouTube studio making documentaries. Real research, real stories, no AI slop. We want every video to feel like a gripping true story, never a slideshow.



Compensation depends on your experience and skill level.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. If you're just starting out as an editor, please don't apply.



The style we want: watch the first 3 minutes of this video (it isn't ours): 



- Mostly still images (old paintings, engravings, archive photos, maps), each brought to life with slow, varied camera moves

- Photo cut-out silhouettes, portrait cards with names, and route maps where a red line draws itself across the sea

- One colour look across the whole video, with red as the only accent

- Hard cuts timed to the narrator's breaths, not a dissolve on every shot

- A clear voice over calm, deep music, with very few sound effects



You'll:

- Turn a script, voiceover and image list into a long-form documentary

- Find and prepare the images: clean them up, cut out figures and objects, and grade them into one look

- Build the maps, cards and text animations

- Mix the voice, music and the occasional sound effect



You have:

- Long-form YouTube documentaries you edited, built mostly from still images

- Real motion-graphics skill (After Effects, Fusion or similar). You can make an old engraving feel alive without it looking like a template

- A good eye for old artwork, and the patience to find the right picture for each line



Not a fit if most of your work is short-form, talking heads, gaming, stock-footage montages or slideshow-style videos.



To apply: start your message with "RETENTION" and send:

1. 2–3 videos you edited. Do NOT send portfolio sites / links they will not be reviewed. 

2. In 1-2 sentences: Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role?

3. Your expected monthly salary



⚠️ Do NOT send portfolio sites or links to portfolios. They won't be watched, and your application won't be considered. Please only send links to the actual edited videos you'd like us to review.

title: Digital Content & Social Media Specialist
description:
We are seeking an exceptionally sharp, creative, tech-savvy, and highly organized Digital Content & Social Media Specialist to support one entrepreneur who has five distinct small businesses/brands based in the United States.



This is a hands-on creative production and publishing position, not a traditional administrative assistant role.



Each business has its own identity, audience, objectives, and content requirements. You will be responsible for helping create, organize, edit, schedule, and publish professional digital content across all five brands while maintaining their individual voices, visual styles, and messaging.



Your primary responsibilities will include social media content creation and publishing, video and podcast editing, blog writing and publishing, and Wix website management.



We are looking for someone who can take original ideas, recordings, and existing materials and transform them into polished, engaging, professional content across multiple platforms.



AI-powered tools are an important part of our workflow, but creative judgment, strong editing skills, attention to detail, and consistent execution matter most.



Because this position supports five businesses, exceptional organization, efficient time management, the ability to switch between different brands, and careful attention to brand consistency are essential.



You must be resourceful, proactive, comfortable working independently, and committed to following instructions completely and accurately.



Primary Responsibilities



Create, edit, schedule, and publish social media content across five brands.



Produce graphics, carousels, Reels, Shorts, thumbnails, and promotional materials.



Edit long-form videos, podcasts, interviews, and short-form clips.



Write, edit, format, and publish blog articles from recordings, transcripts, notes, and original materials.



Update and maintain Wix websites, including pages, images, blog posts, mobile layouts, and basic SEO.



Repurpose existing content for multiple platforms while preserving each brand's individual identity.



Maintain separate content calendars, organized digital assets, and publishing schedules for all five businesses.



Monitor engagement, support community management, and prepare concise performance reports.



Assist with newsletters, online courses, and other digital marketing projects as needed.



Essential Qualifications



Excellent written and spoken English.



Proven social media content creation and publishing experience.



Strong video and podcast editing skills.



Excellent blog writing, proofreading, and publishing abilities.



Hands-on Wix website editing experience.



Strong graphic-design skills and creative judgment.



Exceptional organization and ability to manage multiple brands simultaneously.



Familiarity with AI-assisted production tools and willingness to learn new software.



Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely.



Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and dependable communication.



Professional discretion and strict confidentiality.



Comfort working with Christian faith-based content while preserving the intended message.



Availability for daily 15 minute video check-ins at 7:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time on agreed working days.



20 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours as business needs grow and based on performance.

title: Dispatcher / Scheduler
description:
Position Overview:



 



At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Dispatcher, you will play a key role in coordinating daily moving operations, optimizing fleet efficiency, and ensuring seamless communication between leadership, field teams, and clients.



 



This role requires an organized, proactive problem solver who can manage schedules, dispatch resources, track job progress, and handle real-time operational challenges. You will be responsible for ensuring on-time job completion, driver compliance, and customer satisfaction while maintaining fleet performance and task resolution efficiency.



 



If you thrive in a fast-paced, logistics-driven environment, where your decision-making directly impacts operational success, this is the role for you!



 



Why Join Ready Roles?



 



A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This isn’t a stepping-stone; it’s a role designed for long-term growth. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to build a stable career with a supportive company that invests in their future.



Independence and Opportunity to Lead: Our clients want self-driven assistants who identify opportunities for improvement, find ways to make the business run smoothly, and drive the organization forward without needing to be told what to do. You’ll actively manage the business owner’s schedule and push organizational goals, not just your own tasks.



Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients: We only partner with clients who value stability and respect for their team. As a Ready Role, you’ll work with a business owner who is committed to your success and who shares a long-term vision for growth.



 



Key Responsibilities:



 



1. Scheduling, Dispatching & Resource Allocation



Manage daily schedules and job assignments, ensuring all resources are allocated efficiently.

Collaborate with leadership and operations teams to adjust schedules based on shifting priorities or resource availability.

Monitor task completion in real-time, addressing delays or challenges as they arise.

Optimize mover and fleet utilization to reduce downtime and inefficiencies.

2. Fleet Monitoring & Driver Compliance



Track driver behavior, idle times, route deviations, and log compliance, escalating violations when necessary.

Prepare weekly fleet performance reports, identifying trends and providing actionable insights.

Ensure DOT compliance and company policies are followed regarding driver logs, vehicle inspections, and fleet utilization.

3. Customer Coordination & Satisfaction



Handle mid-move inquiries, schedule updates, and real-time customer issues to ensure timely resolutions.

Track and address recurring client concerns, providing feedback to leadership for continuous improvement.

Proactively communicate last-minute schedule changes with clients to enhance customer satisfaction.

4. Move Close-Outs & Quality Control



Ensure move close-outs are submitted accurately within 20 minutes of job completion.

Address substandard service outcomes immediately, escalating unresolved issues to leadership.

Document patterns in close-out issues and provide insights for operational improvements.

5. Real-Time Communication & Emergency Handling



Act as the primary point of contact for field teams, resolving on-the-ground challenges promptly.

Respond to high-priority escalations with timely intervention and detailed documentation.

Manage last-minute route changes to avoid delays and ensure smooth job execution.

6. Hotel Reservations & Logistics Support



Arrange cost-effective accommodations for drivers when necessary, ensuring timely booking confirmations.

Address emergency booking needs promptly and adjust schedules when required.

7. Task Management & Reporting



Maintain detailed dispatch logs, tracking escalations, task progress, and resolutions.

Provide daily summary reports with key operational insights, wins, and challenges.

Collaborate with leadership to optimize dispatch strategies and implement solutions for recurring operational issues.

8. Technology & Dispatch Tools Management



Utilize SmartMoving, DispatchTrack, Google Suite, Dialpad, Slack, and other dispatch tools to manage schedules and track progress.

Monitor real-time driver performance using GPS tracking systems and escalate inefficiencies as needed.

 



What We’re Looking For:



Proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or fleet management.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills – ability to think on your feet and resolve real-time challenges.

Highly organized & detail-oriented – ability to track multiple moving parts, ensure compliance, and minimize operational disruptions.

Proficiency with dispatching software – experience with SmartMoving, DispatchTrack, GPS tracking, or similar logistics tools is preferred.

Exceptional communication skills – ability to coordinate with drivers, operations teams, and customers professionally and efficiently.

Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset - This role is for someone who naturally takes the initiative and actively finds ways to contribute. You’ll be expected to add value without waiting for instructions and to be a driving force for the business.

Commitment to Long-Term Growth - Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability. We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to build a future with us and the business owner they support.

Aligned with Our Values - Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.

 



Qualifications:



 



Must be based in the Philippines

18 years old and above

Willing to work from home with a stable internet connection

title: Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Apply thru this link :https://bigleaguemovers.bamboohr.com/careers/84





 Position Overview:



 At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As an **Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator**, you’ll serve as a dedicated sales and operations partner for U.S.-based moving companies, with your **primary responsibility focused on outbound calling and lead conversion**.



 This is not an admin or back-office role. Your job is to **create opportunities, engage potential customers, book moving estimates, and drive revenue through strategic outbound communication**.



 Your moving-industry experience will allow you to understand the customer journey, moving operations, scheduling, dispatch, and the urgency involved in coordinating a move.



 The core mission of this role is simple: **turn outbound conversations into booked moving opportunities while supporting the moving company's day-to-day logistics when needed.**



---



 ## Why Join Ready Roles?



 ### A Career Path, Not Just a Job



 This role is designed for growth-minded professionals who want to contribute directly to revenue and become an essential part of a U.S.-based moving company's sales and operations team.



 ### Independence and Opportunity to Lead



 You’ll take ownership of daily outbound calling, lead follow-up, appointment setting, and customer communication. You’ll be expected to manage your pipeline proactively and work the leads like they’re your own book of business.



 ### Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients



 You’ll support clients who value proactive, performance-driven team members who can generate opportunities, communicate professionally, and help the business grow.



---



 # Key Responsibilities:



 ## 1\. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation



 - Conduct daily outbound calls to homeowners, prospects, leads, and potential moving customers.

- Follow up consistently with leads to identify and create moving opportunities.

- Re-engage prospects who previously inquired but did not book.

- Qualify leads and identify customers with potential upcoming moving needs.

- Build rapport and establish trust with potential customers.

- Ask effective questions to understand the customer's moving requirements.

- Communicate the moving company's services clearly and professionally.

- Maintain consistent calling and follow-up activity throughout the day.

- Work toward daily and weekly outbound calling and appointment-setting goals.



 ## 2\. Appointment Setting & Sales Follow-Up



 - Book qualified moving estimates and appointments.

- Follow up with customers who have received estimates or have not yet scheduled.

- Confirm appointments and ensure customers have the correct information.

- Maintain a consistent follow-up schedule for active prospects.

- Track conversations, outcomes, and next steps in the CRM.

- Identify opportunities to move prospects further through the sales process.

- Communicate qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales or operations team.



 ## 3\. Realtor Outreach & Referral Development



 - Conduct outbound calls to local realtors within the client's market.

- Introduce the moving company and establish professional relationships.

- Follow up with realtors to create referral opportunities.

- Maintain a consistent pipeline of potential referral partners.

- Track realtor conversations, follow-ups, and referral opportunities.

- Develop long-term relationships that can generate moving leads.



 ## 4\. Lead Management & Data Activation



 - Work through provided lead and homeowner data to identify potential moving opportunities.

- Prioritize leads based on potential value and likelihood of needing moving services.

- Maintain accurate and organized lead records.

- Remove or flag invalid, inactive, sold, or otherwise unusable leads.

- Update CRM records after calls and customer interactions.

- Ensure every active lead has an appropriate next step or follow-up date.



 ## 5\. Moving Logistics & Customer Coordination



 While **outbound calling is the primary responsibility**, your moving-industry experience will also be used to support logistics and customer coordination.



 - Assist with move scheduling and coordination.

- Communicate with customers regarding move details, confirmations, delays, and updates.

- Coordinate with dispatch, movers, sales, and operations teams.

- Assist with scheduling conflicts and operational issues.

- Understand crew availability and moving schedules.

- Ensure booked customer information is accurately communicated to the operations team.

- Assist with time-sensitive customer and operational requests.



 ## 6\. Tracking & Reporting



 - Log outbound calls, conversations, follow-ups, appointments, and results.

- Maintain accurate records in the client's CRM, Google Sheets, or other systems.

- Track daily outbound activity and appointment-setting performance.

- Provide clear updates on lead activity and pipeline progress.

- Prepare daily or weekly reports as requested.

- Identify patterns and opportunities that can improve outbound performance.



---



 # What We’re Looking For:



 ### Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset



 This role is for someone who naturally takes initiative and actively looks for ways to create opportunities.



 You should not need constant reminders to make calls, follow up with leads, update the CRM, or complete your daily responsibilities.



 ### Confident Outbound Communicator



 You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with homeowners, customers, prospects, and realtors.



 You can handle rejection professionally, maintain energy throughout the day, and continue making calls without losing motivation.



 ### Moving Industry Experience



 You understand how a moving company operates.



 You should have experience working for a moving company and understand concepts such as estimates, customers, crews, scheduling, dispatch, and move coordination.



 ### Results-Oriented



 You understand that outbound calling is not simply about making calls—it is about **creating conversations, generating opportunities, booking estimates, and contributing to revenue**.



 ### Commitment to Long-Term Growth



 Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability. We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to grow with the business they support.



 ### Aligned with Our Values



 Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.



---



 # Qualifications:



 ### Must Have:



 - Must be based in the Philippines.

- 18 years old and above.

- **Minimum 2 years of experience working for a moving company.**

- Previous experience as a Dispatcher, Logistics Coordinator, Move Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar moving-industry position.

- Strong outbound calling and phone communication skills.

- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

- Experience communicating directly with customers.

- Experience with scheduling, coordination, or moving operations.

- Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

- Ability to handle rejection and remain persistent and professional.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and scheduling software.

- Willing to work from home with a stable internet connection.

- Must have your own reliable laptop or PC and noise-cancelling headset.

- Available to work full-time, 40 hours per week.



 ### Preferred Experience:



 - SmartMoving

- Supermove

- Movegistics

- RingCentral

- Google Workspace

- CRM systems

- Outbound calling platforms or dialers

- Lead-generation systems

- Scheduling software



---



 # What You Can Expect from Ready Roles:



 ### Clear Growth Path and Scalable Compensation



 As the business grows and you take on additional responsibilities, the business owner is committed to scaling your compensation. Your role and earning potential can grow as your impact on the business increases.



 ### Supportive, Stable Environment



 Ready Roles partners with respectful, growth-focused clients who are committed to creating positive, long-term working relationships.



 Our goal is to give you the support and resources needed to succeed while helping you become an important part of the client's business.



 ### Training and Development



 You’ll receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support to help you understand the client's business, improve your outbound performance, and develop into a stronger sales and operations professional.



---



 # Why Our Clients Depend on Us



 Our clients are ambitious business owners who trust Ready Roles to help them grow and succeed.



 They need someone who can **pick up the phone, create opportunities, follow up consistently, book appointments, communicate with customers, and take ownership of the sales pipeline.**



 At the same time, they value someone who understands the moving industry and can support logistics and operations when needed.



 We’re looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to **generate business, solve problems, build relationships, and become an essential part of a growing company.**



---



 # Important: This Is an Outbound Calling Role



 **Outbound calling is the primary responsibility of this position.**



 If you are looking for a data-entry, administrative, or quiet back-office position, this role is not for you.



 You should be comfortable spending a significant portion of your workday:



 - Making outbound calls

- Following up with prospects

- Speaking with customers

- Calling realtors

- Qualifying opportunities

- Booking moving estimates

- Updating the CRM

- Driving leads toward conversion



 Your moving-industry experience is what allows you to understand the business and speak confidently with customers—but **your primary mission is to generate moving opportunities through outbound calling.**



---

• Later on, help with
 newsletters, landing page copy, and other ecommerce copy



Use AI as much or as little as you want. But everything you hand in has to sound like a real person said it. Human touch is the job. That means reading every line AI gives you and cutting the slop: the generic, robotic, "this sounds like ChatGPT" writing. If you rely on AI so much that your own thinking disappears, we'll notice.



What we value

• Excellent English, written and spoken. Near native. This is the #1 requirement.

• A real understanding of American culture, social media, memes, and humor

• A grasp of marketing fundamentals like customer desire, market awareness, and market sophistication. Bonus if you’ve read or been inspired by Eugene Schwartz.

• Specific over generic. One real situation beats ten vague benefits.

• Plain spoken copy that sounds like a friend talking to you, not a sales pitch

• Resourcefulness: when ideas run dry, you know how to find inspiration through research, competitor ads, and customer reviews

• Comfort with tools like Notion, Shopify, Amazon, TrendTrack, Tally, and Omnisend for research and customer surveys

• Comfort making accurate, realistic AI videos and images with tools like Higgsfield, Nano Banana, and Runway

• Clear communication, reliability, and long-term consistency

• You take honest constructive criticism well. We give each other direct, constant feedback on our work, and we expect you to keep improving without getting discouraged.



What you get

• Stable, full-time role at 40 hours per week

• Work on your own schedule with only one 30-minute video meeting with our Ecommerce Manager per week

• Salary with room to grow as we scale, plus bonuses at year end

• Paid twice a month through Wise

• A 3-month trial period, with a raise after it if it’s a good fit

• No time tracking. We don't micromanage. We judge your work by results.

• Long-term job security. We are building a team for the future, not short-term gigs.

• A supportive, family-style work culture where your creativity is valued



How to apply

1. Start your application with "Scooch Creative Strategist"

2. Share 4 to 5 ad scripts or sales copy samples you wrote and tell us what part was yours

3. Include a short video introducing yourself in English. Tell us about your experience, what you love about writing, and which copywriters or copywriting books shaped the way you write.



Shortlisted applicants will get a short test task: write a video ad script for our Wingmate phone case from a real brief. After that, we'll set up a Google Meet interview.



Applications missing these items will not be reviewed.

title: Meta Ads Specialist / Media Buyer
description:
We're a U.S.-based company operating three growing businesses across different industries:



DFW Gig Rentals – Vehicle rentals for Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, and other gig economy drivers.



RV Roof Coatings – Professional RV roof sealing, repairs, and protective roof coatings in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.



The Empathy Experience – Empathy belly rentals for couples, baby showers, educational programs, and special events nationwide.



We're looking for a skilled, results-driven Paid Advertising Specialist who can take ownership of our advertising campaigns and help us consistently generate qualified leads and customers.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sets up ads and leaves them running. We want someone who actively monitors performance, tests strategies, identifies opportunities, and recommends improvements.



Responsibilities



Paid Advertising Management



Set up, launch, and manage
 and Instagram advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.



Develop appropriate campaign strategies for each of our three businesses.



Research audiences, competitors, advertising approaches, and creative strategies.



Monitor campaign performance regularly and make adjustments.



Conduct A/B tests involving audiences, headlines, ad copy, video creatives, and calls to action.



Identify winning campaigns and recommend ways to scale them.



Identify poorly performing campaigns and make data-backed improvements.



Manage advertising budgets responsibly within approved limits.



Track leads, conversions, cost per lead, and other relevant performance metrics.



Ensure lead tracking and reporting are properly configured.



Ad Creative & Video Editing



Take existing video footage and images we provide and turn them into advertising creatives.



Edit short-form video advertisements using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools.



Create multiple advertising variations using different hooks, text overlays, captions, and calls to action.



Recommend additional footage or images we should capture to improve results.



Collaborate with our content creator when more advanced editing is needed.



Reporting & Strategy



Provide weekly performance reports for each business.



Explain advertising spend, leads generated, cost per lead, and actual results.



Share what is working, what isn't working, and what should be tested next.



Proactively recommend new advertising strategies.



Help improve the process of turning advertising inquiries into paying customers.



Maintain organized advertising accounts and campaign records.



Required Qualifications



At least 2 years of hands-on experience running Meta advertising campaigns.



Proven experience generating leads or sales through paid advertising.



Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, targeting, campaign objectives, and tracking.



Experience analyzing advertising metrics and improving campaign results.



Ability to create or edit basic video advertising creatives.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple businesses.



Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT for research, creative ideas, and productivity.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with U.S.-based businesses.



Experience advertising local services, rental businesses, or lead-generation offers.



Experience using GoHighLevel CRM.



Familiarity with Google Ads and YouTube Ads.



Experience improving landing pages and lead-conversion funnels.



What Success Looks Like



We want someone who can tell us:



"Campaign A is outperforming Campaign B. Here's why, here's what I recommend changing, and here's the next test I want to run."



Not someone who waits to be told what to do each day.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and a short introduction.



Examples of Meta advertising campaigns you've personally managed.



Actual campaign results showing advertising spend, leads or conversions, and cost per result. Screenshots with sensitive information hidden are acceptable.



A brief explanation of a campaign that wasn't performing and the steps you took to improve it.



Examples of video ads you've edited, if available.



Put your favorite car in the title.



Your desired monthly salary, weekly availability, and earliest possible start date.



Important: Begin your application with the words "Growth Through Results" so we know you've read the entire posting.



We are looking for a long-term team member who genuinely wants to help our businesses grow.

title: Sales Funnel & Paid Ads Specialist — Instagram, Video & Lead Generation
description:
Las Vegas Body Sculpting is hiring an experienced Philippines-based Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist to manage our social media, create compelling video content, and turn inquiries into booked appointments.



We are an established plastic surgery and medical aesthetics practice in Las Vegas with a website, social media accounts, and Prospyr CRM/booking system. You will work directly with our small clinical and front desk team and take ownership of marketing execution.



Las Vegas Body Sculpting is hiring an experienced Philippines-based Sales Funnel & Paid Ads Specialist to turn social media traffic into qualified leads and booked consultations.



We are an established plastic surgery and medical aesthetics practice in Las Vegas. We have a website, Prospyr CRM/booking system, and a website manager who can assist with implementation.



We need someone who can plan and execute a complete booking funnel: compelling video ads, a persuasive landing page, lead capture, follow-up, and appointment booking.



POSITION DETAILS



• Remote — Philippines

• Part-time: initially 20 hours per week

• $8–$12 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience

• Start ASAP

• Paid four-week initial engagement with an agreed weekly hours limit

• Opportunity for a long-term role and additional hours based on results and business needs

• Agreed daily overlap with Las Vegas business hours

• Advertising spend and approved software paid separately by the company



YOUR INITIAL PROJECT



Launch an early Black Friday campaign for one approved service, including:



• One focused, mobile-friendly landing page.

• A clear consultation booking option.

• A useful downloadable PDF guide for prospects who need more information before booking.

• Three initial video ad variations using footage supplied by our team.

• An Instagram/Facebook advertising campaign within an approved budget.

• Lead capture and approved follow-up connected to Prospyr.

• Reporting that tracks inquiries through bookings and attendance.



Target the initial launch within the first week after receiving the necessary access, assets, offer approvals, and website support. Identify dependencies or platform restrictions early.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Sales funnels and landing pages:

• Plan the journey from social video or ad to landing page, inquiry, follow-up, and booking.

• Write persuasive, accurate landing-page copy with clear calls to action.

• Incorporate approved provider videos, patient-authorized before-and-after photos, testimonials, and FAQs.

• Create a downloadable guide and follow-up sequence for prospects still researching.

• Test forms, booking links, and mobile usability.

• Build pages directly if you have the skills, or coordinate implementation with our website manager.



Paid advertising:

• Set up, monitor, and optimize Instagram/Facebook campaigns in Meta Ads Manager.

• Check account health, campaign eligibility, and applicable platform rules before launch.

• Test video hooks, messaging, and creative within an approved budget.

• Evaluate lead quality and booking outcomes.

• Recommend TikTok opportunities for a later phase. TikTok advertising experience is a strong plus.



Video content:

• Turn our raw phone footage into polished short-form advertising videos.

• Add strong hooks, subtitles, and clear booking calls to action.

• Give our team simple scripts and filming instructions.

• Maintain our premium black, gold, and white branding.

• Repurpose campaign videos for organic posting as time allows.



CRM and follow-up:

• Connect inquiries to Prospyr and verify that leads reach the correct workflow.

• Set up or coordinate approved
/SMS follow-up and staff handoffs.

• Stop promotional follow-up appropriately when prospects book or opt out.

• Coordinate with our receptionist, who will support live scheduling conversations.

• Identify missed inquiries and barriers to booking.



Reporting:

• Provide a concise weekly report covering work completed, ad spend, qualified inquiries, bookings, attendance, and next steps.

• Track attributable sales when data is available.

• Keep company accounts, assets, and workflows organized and documented.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience personally building sales funnels for service or appointment-based businesses.

• Hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience beyond boosting posts.

• Strong landing-page copywriting and conversion skills.

• Experience with CRM workflows, lead magnets, and
/SMS nurturing.

• Strong short-form video editing skills.

• Excellent written English and clear communication.

• Ability to prioritize, troubleshoot, and execute independently.



Experience with medical aesthetics, med spas, plastic surgery, cosmetic dentistry, or similar businesses is strongly preferred.



Prospyr experience is a plus. GoHighLevel experience is welcome, but you should assess our existing tools before recommending another platform.



Website editing is helpful but optional because we have a website manager. Please identify which website platforms you can work with.



Patient information must remain in approved systems. Our clinical team will approve pricing, medical claims, and patient materials and handle clinical questions.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with “LVBS FUNNELS” and include:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile.

2. Two funnels you personally built, with links or a screen-recorded walkthrough.

3. Your exact role and available campaign results: timeframe, ad spend, leads, qualified inquiries, bookings, and attended appointments.

4. Three short-form videos or video ads you personally created.

5. Your experience with Meta ads, TikTok ads, CRM automation, Prospyr, and GoHighLevel.

6. A brief explanation of how you would approach our first service-specific funnel.

7. Whether you can edit website pages directly and which platforms you use.

8. Your earliest start date, working availability, and expected hourly rate.

9. Any responsibilities listed above where you would need support.



Remove confidential client and patient information from portfolio examples.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small paid practical assessment using sample or de-identified materials.



We are looking for a reliable long-term partner who combines creative ability, technical execution, and a clear focus on qualified leads and bookings.

title: Customer Service Agent
description:
We’re one of the fastest-scaling brands in the health and wellness supplements space, running branded subscription products on Shopify. We’ve grown immensely over the last few months, and ticket volume grows every day. We’re looking for experienced Customer Support Agents based in the Philippines to join our team. These are long-term roles with real growth potential. We promote from within, and as we scale, so will your responsibilities.



The Role



We serve mostly US-based customers, so this role is fully during US timezone hours. You’ll work fixed shifts during the US day, which means night shifts in the Philippines. The role follows clear SOPs. What matters most is consistency, professionalism, and genuine care for the customer.



What you’ll do:



Respond to all customer inquiries in a timely manner

Handle complaints, refund requests, tracking inquiries, and FAQs

Maintain a professional, on-brand tone in every interaction

Use Claude AI / ChatGPT to help generate and quality-check responses

Contribute to documentation and flag process improvement opportunities

Report on refund and complaint trends

Participate in weekly team calls



Platforms you must know:



Shopify



Claude AI or ChatGPT (we use AI for every response, so comfort with these tools is a must)

 inbox tools (such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Commslayer)

Parcel Panel (bonus)



What we’re looking for:



Minimum 2 years of customer support experience in e-commerce (a hard requirement, not a preference)

Fluent written English: clear, precise, and professional

Comfortable with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow

Available to work fixed shifts during US timezone hours

Available to start immediately

Organized, self-motivated, and honest with time tracking (we use Hubstaff)



Nice to have:



Direct Shopify support experience

Experience in supplements or health and wellness (you can learn our products quickly, so this matters far less than solid e-commerce CS experience)



What we offer:



The chance to be part of one of the fastest-scaling brands in our space, right as we grow

Room to grow your hours and responsibilities quickly as you prove yourself

Direct line to the Co-Founder: short lines, real feedback, and your voice actually heard

Weekly team calls with room to discuss improvements and shape how CS operates

A role that grows with you. We promote from within and reward consistency.



We’re looking for people ready to commit for the longer term and grow with us.



How to Apply



We receive many applications, so we only consider complete ones. Start your application with the word Watermelon, then answer all of the following:



- Your experience: how many years of e-commerce customer support, which brands or products, and which tools you’ve used (Shopify, inbox tools, AI)?

- Availability: which US hours can you work (in EST), how many hours per week, and can you start immediately?

- What you bring: what makes you better than the average support agent? Give one concrete example.

- What you’d improve: in your last support role, what is one thing you improved or would have done differently, and why?

- Sample reply: write your reply to this customer
:

“I cancelled my subscription last week but I was just charged again. This is ridiculous. I want my money back now.”



Applications that miss the keyword or any of the five answers will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

Cristian

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Description: Social Media Manager

Employment Type: [Full-Time]

Location: [Remote]

Schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm US Eastern Standard Time

Reports To: [Marketing Manager]



About the Role



We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Social Media Manager to manage and maintain our company's social media presence across Instagram,
, and YouTube.



This role is responsible for organizing, scheduling, publishing, and monitoring content provided by our internal team. The primary goal is to ensure all content is published accurately, consistently, and on schedule across all three platforms.



This is a social media management and publishing role, not a content creation role. Our team will provide the photos, videos, graphics, and other content assets needed for publication.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Calendar Management

Maintain and manage a centralized social media content calendar for Instagram,
, and YouTube.

Organize upcoming content by platform, publication date, and status.

Track content that has been received, scheduled, published, or is awaiting delivery or approval.

Ensure all scheduled posts align with the established publishing calendar.

Proactively identify gaps in the calendar and communicate any missing content to the appropriate team member.

Keep the content calendar accurate and up to date at all times.



2. Scheduling and Publishing

Schedule and publish content provided by our team across Instagram,
, and YouTube.

Upload and publish posts, Stories, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and long-form YouTube videos as assigned.

Add provided captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, tags, links, and thumbnails.

Ensure content is correctly formatted for each platform.

Verify all posts are scheduled for the correct dates and times.

Review each post before publishing to confirm accuracy and completeness.

Check published content to ensure it appears correctly and address or report any publishing errors.



3. Content Organization and Coordination

Maintain an organized library of content files and publishing materials.

Coordinate with our internal team to collect missing videos, photos, captions, links, or other required assets.

Communicate upcoming deadlines and identify potential delays before they affect the publishing schedule.

Request clarification or approval when content is incomplete or instructions are unclear.

Ensure all content is ready for publication well ahead of its scheduled posting date whenever possible.



4. Social Media Account Management

Maintain our Instagram,
, and YouTube accounts.

Keep profile information and account details accurate and up to date.

Monitor comments, direct messages, and audience interactions as assigned.

Respond to routine inquiries using approved messaging guidelines.

Forward sales inquiries, customer complaints, and sensitive questions to the appropriate team member.

Stay informed about platform updates that may affect scheduling, uploads, or publishing.



5. Performance Monitoring and Reporting

Monitor basic social media analytics, including reach, views, engagement, and follower or subscriber growth.

Track publishing consistency and report missed, delayed, or unsuccessful posts.

Provide regular updates on content published and upcoming scheduled posts.

Identify notable performance changes and share relevant observations with management.

Required Weekly Workflow



The Social Media Manager will follow a consistent workflow to ensure content is managed and published efficiently.



Step 1: Receive and organize content



Collect content and publishing instructions from the internal team.

Confirm that all required files, captions, links, and other materials have been received.

Identify missing items and follow up promptly.



Step 2: Update the content calendar



Enter upcoming posts into the content calendar.

Assign the correct platform, publication date, time, and status to each post.

Identify scheduling gaps and communicate any outstanding content needs.



Step 3: Schedule content



Upload and schedule approved content across Instagram,
, and YouTube.

Add all supplied captions, titles, descriptions, links, tags, and other required details.

Double-check each scheduled post for accuracy before finalizing.



Step 4: Verify publication



Monitor scheduled posts to confirm they publish successfully.

Check for incorrect formatting, missing assets, broken links, or other errors.

Correct issues within the scope of the role or promptly notify management.



Step 5: Review and report



Update the content calendar to reflect completed posts.

Confirm that scheduled content has been published as expected.

Report any outstanding content needs, upcoming gaps, or publishing issues.

Provide a brief weekly summary of completed work and upcoming priorities.

Qualifications and Skills

Previous experience managing business social media accounts.

Familiarity with Instagram,
, and YouTube publishing tools.

Experience using content calendars and social media scheduling platforms.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Excellent time management and communication skills.

Ability to follow established processes and brand guidelines.

Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently.

Comfortable managing multiple accounts and deadlines simultaneously.

Role Boundaries



This position is focused on managing and publishing content supplied by our team.



The role does not include:



Filming or photographing content.

Creating original videos, graphics, or other visual assets.

Designing social media posts or creating thumbnails from scratch.

Developing original content concepts or marketing campaigns.

Writing original content from scratch, unless specifically requested.



Routine publishing tasks, such as formatting supplied captions, adding links, uploading assets, and adjusting content to meet platform requirements, are included.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Publishing consistency: Content is published according to the agreed schedule.

Accuracy: Posts contain the correct files, captions, links, titles, and descriptions.

Organization: The content calendar is current and accurately reflects each post's status.

Accountability: Missed posts and publishing errors are minimized and promptly addressed.

Communication: Missing content and potential delays are flagged before they disrupt the schedule.

Reliability: The weekly workflow is completed consistently and independently.

Reporting: Management receives regular updates on publishing activity and outstanding priorities.

What We're Looking For



We want someone who takes ownership of the social media publishing process and ensures nothing falls through the cracks. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple platforms without needing constant supervision.



This person will help our team maintain a consistent online presence by ensuring that all provided content is organized, scheduled, published, and tracked properly.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction outlining your experience managing Instagram,
, and YouTube accounts. Include examples of accounts you have managed and any experience with content calendars or scheduling tools.

title: Cold Caller – US Merchant Services / Banking (9AM–5PM EST, Leads Provided)
description:
HIRING: EXPERIENCED US BANKING COLD CALLERS (PHILIPPINES)



We are looking for experienced cold callers who understand US banking, financial transactions, and payment risks.



We provide the leads. Your job is to contact US business owners, discuss potential red flags in their banking transactions, explain possible risks, and help them understand how to avoid similar issues in the future.



SCHEDULE



* Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time

* Full-time, 40 hours/week

* Long-term position



YOUR ROLE



* Call US businesses using our provided leads

* Discuss potential suspicious or flagged banking transactions

* Explain payment risks and possible consequences

* Build trust and communicate confidently with business owners

* Book qualified appointments with our specialists

* Record call outcomes and follow US calling regulations



REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent spoken English

* 3+ years of US cold calling experience (6+ preferred)

* Strong understanding of US banks, ACH, wire transfers, transaction monitoring and payment risks

* Previous experience in US banking, financial services or fraud prevention preferred

* Confident, persuasive and professional communication

* Reliable computer, internet and headset



SALARY



* $800–$1,000 monthly base

* Additional performance-based commissions

* Potential earnings up to $20,000/month for exceptional performers



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with “US BANKING CALLER”.

2. Send a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating a cold call to a US business owner. Explain a potential banking transaction red flag, why it matters, and how the business can prevent future issues.

3. Share your US cold calling experience, campaigns, daily call volume and results.

4. Explain in your own words:

    * What is the difference between ACH and wire transfers?

    * What causes a bank to flag a transaction?

    * What happens when a bank detects suspicious payment activity?



Important: Callers must not impersonate banks or claim that a specific transaction has been flagged without verified evidence.



Applications without a voice recording or relevant experience will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor, For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused. AI-augmented. Long-term.



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets, and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land, who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics

Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Compensation: [800-1,200] USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3-4 finished edits per day

What you'll own

Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok: fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent. Every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll. You know the first 1-2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook, Problem, Mechanism, CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools: realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences

Non-negotiables

Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal, not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption, without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training, but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have

VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure: formats, ratios, placements

Who fits here

You think like a marketer, not just a creative. You care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard. You take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer. You communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal. We'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same

What we offer

This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:



Access to a premium AI tool stack (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more), all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks. You'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path: clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty. We're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us

How to apply

Send your portfolio (3-5 ad edits you're proud of, DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred) + expected monthly salary to my WhatsApp: 
If the requirements are not sent, you will be ignored.

THE ROLE

You will run the full property-sourcing process, not just collect listings:

1. Search HotPads and Zillow every day for single-family homes listed for rent by the owner (FRBO) that fit our buy box.

2. Send first messages to landlords using our approved scripts.

3. Follow up on replies and book viewings.

4. Log every contact and conversation in our lead-tracking spreadsheet (Criteria).

5. Check each property against the client's criteria and mark the good ones "Hot" for our team to review.

6. Keep a daily count of contacts, replies, viewings booked and Hot leads.



Starting markets: North Carolina (Wake Forest, Rolesville, Clayton, Apex, Raleigh, North Raleigh). We may add Dallas–Fort Worth and other NC areas later.



BUY BOX (what we look for)

- Single-family house, listed for rent by the owner

- NOT: HOA communities, condos, townhomes, duplexes, homes on well water, homes managed by a property manager, realtor listings, or homes with carpet throughout



Week-1 targets: at least 25 landlord contacts, 5 replies, 2 viewings booked and 1 qualified Hot lead.



IMPORTANT – HOW WE TALK TO LANDLORDS

You will always describe us as a coaching and education company. Never say or suggest that BnB Launch brokers deals, negotiates leases, or "secures leases" for anyone. Use only our approved message templates. Your first 10 messages will be reviewed by our team before they are sent.



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English. You must write friendly, natural messages that a US landlord will answer.

- Must work at least 4 hours a day during US Eastern business hours (about 9 PM–3 AM Philippine time).

- Experience in real-estate outreach, lead generation, short-term rentals (Airbnb or Vrbo) or property management preferred

- Comfortable using Zillow, HotPads and Google Sheets

- Detail-oriented. You log everything and follow rules exactly.

- Reliable internet and your own computer



COMPENSATION (independent contractor, commission only)

This is a commission-only contract role. There is no salary or retainer.

- $500 USD when a property you sourced fits the buy box, the landlord has replied with a viewing booked or solid written interest, and our team accepts it as Hot in our tracker

- Another $500 USD when that same property reaches "Signed" (lease executed for our client)

- That is $1,000 total per property that signs.

- Rules: one payout per unique address per client. No pay for listings with no landlord contact, and no pay for leads that were already Hot before you were assigned. Payment is made within 14 days of each milestone after we confirm it in the tracker.

- Paid trial: shortlisted applicants complete a 30-minute paid test ($15 USD) scoring 5 live listings against our buy box. The test involves no landlord contact.



ONBOARDING

You will receive our acquisition SOP, message templates, the buy-box checklist and access to the tracker. For your first week we will check your work daily.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "FRBO" so we know you read this post.

2. Answer the screening questions below.

3. Include a short sample: a 3–4 sentence first message you would send a landlord who has a 3-bedroom house for rent on Zillow.

4. List the US Eastern hours you can work.

Applications without the sample will not be reviewed.



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Describe your experience with real-estate, rental or lead-generation outreach. What platforms did you use, and roughly how many contacts per day?

2. Which US Eastern hours can you reliably work each day?

3. Here is a Zillow listing: a townhome in an HOA, listed by a property management company. Would you contact this landlord? Why or why not?

4. A landlord replies, "What exactly does your company do?" Write your answer in 2–3 sentences.

5. This role is commission only ($500 + $500 per property). Are you comfortable with that? How do you plan your time to hit results?

6. What would you write in the tracker after a landlord agrees to a viewing?

7. (Optional) Have you used Google Sheets to track leads? Describe how you organized it.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About MAVI



MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.



We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.



The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.



Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.



The Role



We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to own the monthly close and core financial reporting of a high-growth US company, working remotely from Philippines.



This is not a task-execution role. You will own a complete accounting workstream from the first journal entry to the final reconciliation, and you will be accountable for the accuracy of what leaves your hands. Where the close relies on manual workarounds or undocumented steps, you will be expected to fix them rather than repeat them.



You will work directly with the Controller, finance leadership, and the US stakeholders who rely on your numbers. A meaningful part of the role is explaining material movements clearly and flagging risks before they become late adjustments.

Because you will be working remotely with a lean US finance team, the role calls for someone who manages their own calendar, communicates proactively, and resolves issues without waiting to be asked.



What You'll Own



The Close and Reporting



1. The close: Own the month-end and year-end close for one or more entities, including the checklist, deadlines, and quality of output.

2. Journal entries and schedules: Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue, and fixed asset schedules with clear supporting documentation.

3. Reconciliations: Own balance sheet reconciliations, resolving reconciling items rather than carrying them forward.

4. Financial statements: Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow support under US GAAP, and explain the movements behind them.

5. Flux analysis: Investigate unusual movements, identify root causes, and explain the financial statement impact to leadership.



Controls and Audit Readiness



1. Audit-ready support: Maintain schedules and documentation that an auditor or reviewer can follow without a walkthrough.

2. Process improvement: Improve close checklists, SOPs, and recurring workflows so each close runs faster and cleaner than the last.

3. Audit and tax support: Prepare PBC requests and the accounting inputs external CPA firms depend on.



Accounting Operations and Partnership



1. Transactional review: Review AP, AR, payroll, and expense activity for correct coding, cut-off, and accrual treatment.

2. Stakeholder communication: Communicate directly with US finance leaders, surfacing risks, dependencies, and open items early.

3. Systems: Work within the company's ERP and finance tools, and identify opportunities for automation.



What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience with meaningful ownership of the month-end close

- Hands-on experience with US GAAP, supporting US companies, US entities, or international businesses that report under US GAAP

- Strong accrual accounting fundamentals; candidates with transferable PFRS or IFRS experience and practical US-client exposure will also be considered

- Experience preparing the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow support

- Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842)

- ERP experience with QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, or a comparable system; familiarity with tools such as Ramp, Brex, 
, or Gusto is an advantage

- Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

- The ability to own a workstream independently, investigate root causes, and resolve issues before they need senior escalation

- Experience working remotely with US-based stakeholders

- Excellent written and verbal English

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field



Preferred



- Philippine CPA (PRC-licensed), US CPA, ACCA, or equivalent (completed or in progress)

- Big 4 or public accounting experience, or experience at a firm serving US clients

- Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company

- Multi-entity or intercompany accounting exposure

- SaaS, e-commerce, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience



Who This Role Is For



This role suits an accountant who is ready to own the close outright rather than contribute one piece of it.

title: Controller
description:
About MAVI



MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.



Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.



The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.



We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.



The Role



We are seeking an experienced Controller to own the accounting function of a high-growth US company, working remotely from Philippines.



This is the senior accounting seat in the business. You will be accountable for the integrity of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and readiness for audit. Where the company has outgrown the processes that carried it this far, you will be the person who rebuilds them.



You will work directly with the CEO, finance leadership, and department heads, translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, before they ask.



What You'll Own



The Close and the Financial Statements

• The close: Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with full accountability for the calendar, quality, and cycle time.

• The financial statements: Own the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind them in front of leadership, auditors, and the board.

• Technical accounting: Conclude and document positions on revenue recognition, leases, equity, accruals, and capitalization.• • Multi-entity accounting: Own consolidation, intercompany, and foreign currency where the group has more than one entity.



Controls, Audit, and Tax

• Policies and controls: Establish and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows appropriate to the company's stage.

• Audit: Lead the annual audit or review end to end, from PBC preparation through resolution of findings.• Tax coordination. Coordinate US tax compliance with external CPA firms and own the accounting inputs they depend on.



Team, Systems, and Partnership

• The team: Lead and develop the accounting team, and manage external accounting partners against agreed standards.

• Systems and process: Lead ERP and automation projects, and build processes that hold up at the next stage of growth.

• Business partnership: Give FP&A and department leaders the reporting, KPIs, and variance analysis they depend on.



What We're Looking For



• 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leading an accounting team

• Independent ownership of the close and the financial statements, not contribution to someone else's

• Strong command of US GAAP, PFRS, or IFRS, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842)

• Familiarity with supporting clients or entities in the US, UK, Australia, or Canada

• Experience leading an audit or review and managing external auditors

• A track record of building or rebuilding accounting processes and controls

• Substantial experience with a major ERP, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, or QuickBooks Online

• Experience presenting results to executive leadership and defending conclusions

• Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to lead discussions with executives and auditors

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification



Preferred



• Philippine CPA (PRC-licensed), US CPA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred

• Experience using AI tools in accounting workflows, with the judgment to review and correct AI-generated output

• Multi-entity consolidation and intercompany experience

• Big 4 or public accounting experience followed by industry experience

• Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly Seed through Series C

• Carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end



Who This Role Is For



An accounting leader who wants to own a function outright: technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and equally credible with a CEO, an auditor, and a junior accountant. Above all, you identify issues early and arrive with a practical recommendation, not only a number.



Why Join Through MAVI



• Own an entire accounting function, with direct exposure to founders and senior leadership

• Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's

• Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll

- Experience in real estate wholesaling, transaction coordination, or operations management.

- Strong knowledge of the contract-to-closing process.

Role Title: Offshore QA Tester

Team: QA / Engineering

Location: Offshore (with required overlap to U.S. Mountain/Central hours)

Type: Contractor

Reports To: QA Lead, with oversight from Product Manager and Technical Leads



Role Summary:



We are seeking an Offshore QA Tester to execute manual and regression testing across our multi-tenant SaaS platform. This role involves validating functionality, documenting reproducible issues, performing data integrity checks, and supporting QA documentation throughout our sprint and release cycles.



Candidates must bring strong manual QA skills, solid automation experience (in any tool), and the ability to ramp quickly into Cypress.



Responsibilities:



Execute manual and regression test cases across Regional and Hub tenants



Log reproducible bugs with clear, detailed documentation



Validate data integrity across Postgres (pgAdmin) and MongoDB



Re-test fixed tickets and maintain regression logs



Support QA documentation and provide test evidence



Participate in daily QA syncs and provide async updates



Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure high-quality releases



Required Skills & Tools:



2–4 years of experience in QA or software testing



Strong manual and regression testing experience for SaaS platforms



Hands-on experience with at least one QA automation tool (mandatory)



Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Robot Framework, Katalon, etc.



Experience with:



ClickUp (or similar QA/ticketing tools)



Google Sheets for test data and reporting



Mailtrap (or similar
 testing tools)



Postgres (pgAdmin) and MongoDB for data validation



Chrome DevTools for debugging and validation



Strong written and verbal English communication



High attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency



Automation Expectations:



Familiarity with automation concepts: selectors, assertions, test structure, debugging



Ability to read, understand, and run automated tests



Ability to contribute to an existing regression automation suite



Willingness and ability to learn Cypress quickly during onboarding



Preferred Skills:



Exposure to Laravel, Vue.js, REST APIs, Postman



Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS systems



Understanding of compliance or data-sensitive environments



Success Metrics:



High-quality test execution and reproducible bug reporting



Timely completion of regression cycles



Clear test summaries and documentation



Reduction in missed defects during UAT



Proactive communication and collaboration with QA, Product, and Engineering

title: Healthcare Sales Executive (Remote)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're looking for a driven, healthcare-savvy sales professional to accelerate MedPro Disposal's channel growth and expand our national partner network. In this high-impact, fully remote role, you'll build relationships with healthcare associations, technology platforms, and other strategic partners to drive new business and long-term value — generating qualified leads through high-volume outbound prospecting, solution selling, and demos, while nurturing partner relationships for new opportunities.



Key Responsibilities:

• Research and target healthcare prospects through outbound calls, email, and LinkedIn

• Conduct high-volume outreach to uncover pain points and communicate solution value

• Build and nurture relationships through the initial stages of the sales cycle; maintain communication with partner channels

• Deliver tailored software demos addressing client-specific needs and compliance goals

• Overcome objections, present compelling solutions, and win new business

• Log all activity and progress in Salesforce, HubSpot, and outreach tools

• Collaborate with partners to source new deals, educate them on MedPro's offerings, and provide regular updates



Required Qualifications:

• 4–5+ years of healthcare sales experience in a quota-carrying role (required)

• Proven ability to prospect, qualify, present, negotiate, and close

• Strong verbal and written communication, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM/pipeline tools

• Strong time management and ability to juggle multiple deals at once

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

• Drive to grow into a senior channel sales role within 12–18 months



Nice-to-Have

• Business development or channel sales experience

• A natural "hunter" sales mentality



Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive hourly rate of $8/hour, based on experience and performance

• Full-time role (40 hours/week), Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM CST with weekly pay

• Paid time off and U.S. holidays

• Long-term remote role with growth potential within a U.S.-based organization

• Work anniversary bonuses

• Collaborative and performance-driven culture focused on professional development and results

• Performance-driven environment with clear daily KPIs tied to call activity, appointment setting, and show rates

• Opportunity to work directly with Sales and Account Executive teams, contributing to client expansion and revenue growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling sales organization supporting MedPro Disposal 

• Exposure to B2B client engagement, onboarding workflows, and cross-functional collaboration



Technical Requirements:

• Personal laptop or desktop (i5 5th gen or AMD equivalent, 8GB RAM minimum)

• Stable primary internet connection (at least 25-30 Mbps) + backup internet source

• Noise-canceling headset and quiet, dedicated work environment



Application Process

1. To submit your application, please email the following to 

2. Your most updated resume

3. Use the following subject line:

[Your Full Name] – Healthcare Sales Executive – Remote



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement



MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
