Position Overview:

The Controller exists to own the financial backbone of a scaling, multi-company organization — keeping the books accurate, timely, and audit-ready every month. Working remotely from the Philippines on US business hours, the role starts inside MedPro Disposal and extends across Accordant Capital’s portfolio of operating companies, including MP1 Solutions and future portfolio additions. Reporting to the US-based VP of Finance, this is a hands-on role: owning the full accounting cycle and close, developing the controls and processes a growing business needs, and bringing modern ERP/FP&A tooling, AI-enabled automation, and operating discipline (EOS or a similar system) to the accounting function. Success looks like a close that runs like clockwork across every company, consolidations that reconcile cleanly, and a well-run accounting operation the executive team can rely on. 



Key Responsibilities:

● Own the full accounting cycle — general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll (US payroll via third-party provider), and month-end close 



● Manage financial consolidation, intercompany transactions and eliminations, and consolidated reporting in partnership with the VP of Finance as the finance function expands across multiple companies 



● Manage cash flow forecasting, daily cash positioning, and bank reconciliations 



● Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with US GAAP, at the individual company and consolidated level 



● Develop and maintain internal financial controls and accounting policies; support compliance with US federal, state, and local tax and regulatory requirements in coordination with external US CPA and tax advisors 



● Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and FP&A in partnership with the VP of Finance, including budget-to-actual reporting 



● Directly manage and mentor a small finance/accounting team (US and/or PH-based) [OPEN – confirm direct reports], ensuring accurate, well-documented work across the function 



● Maintain and optimize accounting systems and ERP (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar); identify gaps in existing processes and implement scalable improvements 



● Apply AI and automation tools to streamline reconciliations, close, and recurring reporting 



● Support the operating cadence with finance scorecards, quarterly priorities, and accountability rhythms (EOS/Traction or a similar operating system) 



● Partner closely with the US-based VP of Finance and executive team across time zones — clear documentation, async updates, and full close-calendar visibility 



Required Qualifications:



● Years of experience: 8–9 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including a minimum of 2–5 years in a Controller or equivalent leadership role 



● Industry background: Demonstrated experience supporting US-based companies (in-house or offshore/remote), ideally in a startup, founder-led, or PE-backed small-company environment (under 200 employees) 



● Multi-entity scope: Hands-on multi-entity accounting experience — intercompany transactions, eliminations, and consolidations 



● Technical skills: Strong command of US GAAP and financial reporting standards; proficiency in accounting/ERP software and Microsoft Excel 



● Education: Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance, or a related field 



● Other: Hands-on experience with bank reconciliation, cash management, and financial close processes 



● Communication: Excellent written and spoken English



● Work setup: Able to work US Central business hours (PH night shift) full-time; dedicated home office with reliable primary and backup internet and power 



Big Pluses:

● EOS experience — working within the Entrepreneurial Operating System (scorecards, Rocks, Level 10 meetings) or a comparable operating cadence 



● AI experience — practical use of AI and automation tools in close, reconciliation, or reporting workflows 



● FP&A and ERP tools — FP&A exposure and hands-on experience with modern ERP and planning platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Adaptive, Planful, Cube, or similar) 



Nice-to-Have:

● Licensed CPA (Philippines) or CMA certification 



● Experience in healthcare, waste management, logistics, or a service-based industry 



● Experience with US sales/use tax, 1099 reporting, or multi-state compliance 



● Familiarity with HR administrative processes and people operations 



● Track record of building finance teams and processes in a growing, multi-company environment 



Compensation & Benefits:

• Pay starts at $1500 per month (based on experience)

• Pay Frequency: Weekly pay

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift)

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work required on US Holidays



Technical Requirements:

• Reliable primary internet connection (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection

• Updated computer or laptop capable of running video calls, Google Workspace/Microsoft Office, and collaboration tools smoothly

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace free of distractions

• Backup power source recommended for your area

title: Senior Amazon & Shopify Listing Manager
description:
NOCRY makes protective gear for the trades: knee pads, safety eyewear, gloves and face shields. Our purpose is simple: every worker goes home whole, every shift. Founded in 2012 and worn by 5 million since, we’re building the most trusted name in protective gear for the trades, head to toe.



We’re looking for a senior Listing Manager to manage product catalog on Amazon (NA and EU) and on our Shopify store, 
. You’ll set the standards, d
 the priorities and do the work. This role has a direct, visible impact on how people find and buy our gear. It is a full-time role working exclusively for NOCRY.



What you’ll do



Amazon



- Manage NOCRY’s catalog strategy across four marketplaces and d
 which listings to improve first, based on revenue impact

- Own every part of the product detail page: titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, A+ content and attributes

- Lead new product launches on the listing side, from setup and variations to content and indexing checks

- Manage complex catalog work: flat files, category listing reports, variation families, parent/child restructures and marketplace localisation

- Monitor listing changes daily and resolve issues fast: suppressions, catalog conflicts, broken variations, wrong categories and unauthorised edits

- Escalate and push cases with Seller Support and Brand Registry until they’re resolved



Shopify



- Manage product pages on 
: product data, variants, descriptions, images, metafields and collections

- Set up new products for launch and keep product information consistent between Amazon and Shopify



Across both



- Build and maintain listing standards, templates and SOPs so the catalog stays consistent as we grow

- Stay ahead of Amazon and Shopify changes, and tell us what they mean for NOCRY



What we expect



- 3+ years of hands-on Seller Central experience owning a brand’s catalog

- Experience with multiple Amazon marketplaces, ideally including the EU

- Expert with flat files, variations, catalog conflicts and Brand Registry cases

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Able to work independently, set your own priorities and take full ownership



How to apply



 
 with the subject “Senior Listing Manager at NOCRY” and include:



1. A video introduction (2 to 3 minutes, camera on, in English). Tell us:



- who you are and your Amazon background

- one listing or product page you improved: what you changed, why, and what happened to the results

- why you want this role

- Biggest issue on Amazon you have managed to resolve and how.



Send it as a link (Loom, unlisted YouTube or Google Drive). Please make sure the link is viewable by anyone who has it.



2. Written answers to these questions:



- How many years have you worked in Seller Central and for which kinds of brands? Please share 2 or 3 ASINs or product pages you’ve managed.

- Do you currently work for any other Amazon seller, Shopify brand or agency? If so, which one, and how many hours a week?

- Do you have your own computer and a reliable internet connection?

- Pick any NOCRY product on Amazon, and tell us one thing you’d change and why. A few sentences is enough.



Applications without a video won’t be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager 

Job Type: Full-Time

Work Setup: Remote

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager / Company Leadership

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Social Media Manager to build, organize, manage, and automate our social media presence across multiple platforms.

This role goes beyond simply creating and posting content. The ideal candidate will be responsible for establishing a strong and consistent Rate DNA presence across social platforms, connecting our accounts and marketing tools, creating efficient workflows, and automating repetitive tasks wherever possible.

You will help build a social media system that is organized, scalable, responsive, and designed to generate engagement and qualified leads with minimal manual effort.

Platforms

The Social Media Manager will manage and/or establish Rate DNA's presence on platforms including:

-

- Instagram

- Threads

- LinkedIn

- TikTok

- X 
)

- Nextdoor

- Google Business Profile

- Alignable

- Other relevant social and business platforms as needed

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Account Setup & Management

- Create, claim, verify, and optimize Rate DNA profiles across all relevant platforms.

- Ensure all accounts use consistent branding, company information, contact details, logos, descriptions, and visual identity.

- Secure accounts using appropriate passwords, permissions, two-factor authentication, and administrator access.

- Maintain an organized record of account access, ownership, and platform credentials.

- Identify additional platforms and directories that may benefit Rate DNA's online presence.

2. Social Media Management & Scheduling

- Set up and maintain a centralized social media scheduling and management system using tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar platforms.

- Build and maintain a monthly content calendar.

- Schedule content across multiple platforms while adapting posts to each platform's format and audience.

- Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

- Monitor scheduled content and troubleshoot publishing issues.

3. Content Creation

- Create engaging social media posts relevant to mortgage, real estate, home financing, interest rates, and related topics.

- Develop graphics using Canva or similar design tools.

- Create and edit short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts when applicable.

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats and platforms.

- Develop educational, promotional, community-focused, and lead-generation content.

- Maintain consistent Rate DNA branding and messaging across all content.

4. Social Media Automation

- Identify repetitive social media and marketing tasks that can be automated.

- Build and maintain workflows for:

  - Cross-posting

  - Content scheduling

  - Automated responses

  - DM triggers

  - Lead notifications

  - Lead routing

  - CRM updates

  - Internal team notifications

- Connect social media platforms with CRM and other business systems using tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Test automations regularly and troubleshoot failed workflows.

- Continuously look for ways to reduce manual work while maintaining quality and personalization.

5. Lead Management & Routing

- Monitor comments, direct messages, inquiries, and social media leads.

- Respond to basic inquiries promptly and professionally.

- Identify potential sales leads and route them to the appropriate team member or CRM.

- Ensure lead information is captured accurately.

- Create automated lead-routing workflows where appropriate.

- Track the source of leads generated through social media.

6. Community Management

- Monitor comments, mentions, reviews, and messages across platforms.

- Respond to customers and prospects in a professional, helpful, and timely manner.

- Escalate questions or complaints that require management or specialized assistance.

- Monitor brand mentions and relevant conversations.

- Maintain a positive and professional online presence for Rate DNA.

7. Mortgage & Real Estate Compliance

- Ensure social media content follows applicable mortgage and real estate advertising requirements.

- Follow company guidelines regarding NMLS information, Equal Housing Opportunity requirements, disclosures, licensing information, and advertising language.

- Review content for compliance before publishing.

- Work with management/compliance personnel when clarification or approval is required.

- Stay informed about company-specific marketing and compliance requirements.

8. Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor social media performance across platforms.

- Track key metrics including:

  - Engagement

  - Followers and audience growth

  - Reach and impressions

  - Website traffic

  - Leads generated

  - Messages and inquiries

  - Content performance

- Prepare a monthly social media performance report.

- Identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

- Provide recommendations based on data and performance trends.

9. Continuous Improvement

- Research new social media features, tools, automation opportunities, and emerging platforms.

- Recommend new tools or workflows that can improve efficiency.

- Test new content formats and strategies.

- Continuously improve Rate DNA's social media presence and lead-generation process.

- Stay current with changes to platform algorithms, policies, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Strong experience managing multiple social media platforms.

- Experience creating social media content, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Experience with social media scheduling and management platforms.

- Strong understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

- Experience connecting social media platforms with CRMs or other business applications.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple platforms simultaneously.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic technical and automation issues.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with a mortgage, real estate, financial services, or related company.

- Knowledge of mortgage and real estate advertising compliance.

- Experience with NMLS and Equal Housing requirements.

- Experience with CRM platforms and lead-routing systems.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

- Experience with Google Business Profile.

- Experience building automated marketing workflows.

- Basic understanding of SEO and local marketing.

- Experience managing online reviews and business listings.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new platforms.

- Automation-minded and always looking for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Creative and able to produce engaging content.

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Detail-oriented, especially when managing multiple accounts and automations.

- Organized and capable of maintaining a clear content calendar and workflow.

- Analytical and able to use data to improve performance.

- Reliable and responsive when managing comments, messages, and leads.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

- Successful setup and optimization of all required social media accounts.

- Consistency and quality of social media content.

- Growth in followers and engagement.

- Increase in reach and brand visibility.

- Number and quality of leads generated.

- Response time to comments and inquiries.

- Successful implementation of automation workflows.

- Reduction in repetitive manual social media tasks.

- Accuracy of lead routing and CRM updates.

- Compliance with company and industry advertising requirements.

- Timely and accurate monthly reporting.

Working Relationship

The Social Media Manager will work closely with management, marketing, sales, and other team members to ensure that social media activity supports Rate DNA's overall marketing and lead-generation goals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of the social media ecosystem—from account setup and branding to content creation, automation, engagement, lead routing, analytics, and continuous optimization.

title: Data Analytics & Research
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Scaffold Industry Data Research & Validation Specialist to perform in-depth research, validation, and maintenance of critical market data for scaffolding companies, manufacturers, and equipment suppliers. In this role, you will be responsible for validating core business details—including parent company structures, official websites, facility/location counts, core business models (rental, sales, labor), and industry categorizations—and accurately updating our master tracking spreadsheets (such as the SE Company Pre-Check Tracker).



Key Responsibilities

Core Business Research: Conduct rigorous research to identify and verify core company profiles, parent organization hierarchies, official domains, operating locations, and primary business scopes.



Spreadsheet & System Updates: Systematically update and manage tracking spreadsheets, ensuring all data fields match verified industry sources and adhere to formatting guidelines.



Data Accuracy & Quality Control: Verify business offerings (e.g., distinguishing between sales, rentals, and field labor) and categorize companies correctly (e.g., Scaffold Contractor, Products Supplier, Manufacturer, Multi-Craft Contractor).



Information Validation: Audit existing records against primary corporate documentation, industry directories, and official filings to eliminate duplicates, obsolete web domains, or outdated operational scopes.



Workflow Tracking: Track company review statuses through stages (e.g., Ready for Review, Approved & Uploaded) to maintain real-time accuracy across team trackers.



Critical Requirement: High Data Accuracy

Data precision is paramount to our operations and market analysis. Inaccurate business categorization, incorrect parent company relationships, or outdated contact details directly impact strategic decision-making, operational efficiency, and outreach success. Candidates must demonstrate an exceptional commitment to quality, thorough cross-referencing habits, and zero tolerance for unverified or speculative data entries.



Qualifications & Requirements

Scaffolding Industry Experience (BIG PLUS): Prior experience in the scaffolding, access equipment, shoring, or heavy construction sectors is highly preferred. Familiarity with scaffold equipment types, industry terminology, and major market players will enable significantly faster, higher-quality research and verification.



Technical Proficiency: Strong command of Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (including filtering, status tracking, structural alignment, and data verification workflows).



Research & Analytical Skills: Advanced web research capability to identify official business entities, parent-subsidiary structures, and regional operational footprints.



Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data input, consistency, and quality checking.



Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills to flag discrepancies or consult with team members on ambiguous edge cases.



Preferred Background

Background as an estimator, project coordinator, data analyst, or market researcher within scaffolding, shoring, formwork, or industrial services.



Familiarity with industry organizations (e.g., Scaffold & Access Industry Association / SAIA) and safety/regulatory frameworks.

title: Shopify Developer — CRO & AOV Test Implementation
description:
We’re looking for a Shopify developer who can turn our conversion rate optimization (CRO) and average order value (AOV) ideas into reliable, ready-to-launch experiments.



We own the ideas, hypotheses, and priorities. You own the technical execution. Your role is to understand each test brief, flag technical limitations, build the experience, and make sure it works properly across devices.



What you’ll do



- Implement CRO and AOV tests across product pages, landing pages, collection pages, and the cart.

- Build and modify Shopify sections, templates, and reusable components.

- Execute ideas such as bundles, quantity breaks, upsells, cross-sells, free-shipping progress bars, sticky add-to-cart buttons, and offer messaging.

- Set up test variants in our testing platform and verify that targeting and tracking work correctly.

- Integrate and customize apps where needed, recommending custom development when it’s the better fit.

- QA each test across mobile and desktop, checking product variants, discounts, cart behavior, and key purchase journeys.

- Protect site speed and existing functionality when shipping changes.

- Roll out winning tests, remove losing variants, and keep the codebase organized.



What we’re looking for



- AI first (utilizing all the latest ai tools to help with your output)

- Strong hands-on Shopify development experience.

- Confidence with Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Shopify themes, and Online Store 2.0.

- Experience implementing ecommerce experiments or conversion-focused storefront changes.

- Familiarity with A/B testing tools, analytics events, and tracking validation.

- Strong mobile implementation skills and attention to visual detail.

- An understanding of Shopify’s checkout, discount, and app limitations.

- Clear communication, realistic delivery estimates, and dependable follow-through.



How we’ll work



You’ll receive a test brief outlining the idea, intended customer experience, and success metric. You’ll clarify implementation details, estimate the work, build the test, and provide a preview for review before launch.



You should be comfortable working from a clear brief without always needing a pixel-perfect design. We expect you to flag edge cases and suggest practical implementation improvements while staying focused on the test.



What success looks like



- Tests move from brief to launch quickly and reliably.

- Implementations match the intended customer experience.

- Tracking is validated before launch.

- Changes work smoothly on mobile and desktop.

- Bugs, performance regressions, and unnecessary complexity are kept to a minimum.



You’ll be measured on execution quality, delivery speed, and reliability—not whether every hypothesis wins.



To apply, please fill-in this application form: 



Please fill-in the "Additional Information" section:



- Two or three relevant Shopify projects and what you personally built.

- An example of a CRO or AOV experiment you implemented.

- Your availability

title: AI Video Hook Creator + CapCut Editor – Full-Time, Long-Term (US E-commerce)
description:
Do you want to work full-time with the newest AI video tools and get paid more when your videos perform?



We are a growing e-commerce brand that sells to the US. Our ads are AI UGC videos: short clips that look like a real person filmed them with a phone. We are building a team of editors who make these videos for us every day, and we want people who stay with us long-term (at least 1 year) and grow with us.



You do not post anything and you do not talk to any customers. You only make videos. We give you everything else.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Every day you make 20–30 short vertical videos (9:16) in your 8 hours.

- Each video starts with an AI hook: a 4–6 second clip you generate in our workspace with the latest models (Seedance 2.0, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 Prime).

- You do not need to be a prompt expert. You get your own Claude seat with our custom skills: you describe the hook in your own words, Claude writes the prompt for you, you paste it into our workspace and generate.

- Then a quick edit in CapCut (the free version is enough): your hook + 3–4 of our B-roll clips + the music we send you, cut on the beat, with one text over the video and a call-to-action at the end. 10–15 seconds.

- The B-rolls are mostly the same in every video, so the edit takes only minutes. 20–30 videos a day sounds like a lot, but most of your time goes into creating the hooks.

- You upload your videos to our workspace. We review them and tell you exactly what to improve.

- Later you also make variations of our best videos (for example the same video with a new text), so we can test what sells best.



WHY YOU WILL LIKE THIS JOB

- You learn AI video creation, one of the most wanted skills right now, with the best tools, paid by us.

- Everything is ready for you: products, B-rolls, music, texts and the AI tools are all in one workspace.

- We train you and give you feedback every day until you are really good.

- Long-term, stable full-time work from home with a written contract.

- Your pay grows with your skill and your results, and the best videos earn extra bonuses.



PAY

- Start: $500 per month while you learn our way of working (full-time, 8 hours a day).

- After the training your pay goes up, to as much as $800 per month, depending on your skill and your results.

- Bonuses on top: when a video you made performs well in our market, you get a bonus for that video, from $5 up to $100 or more. One great video can earn you $100 or more extra.

- Paid every 14 days or monthly, as we agree with you. You send an invoice to our company for each payment (we give you the template).



WHAT YOU NEED

- Experience editing short vertical videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).

- Experience creating AI videos, especially AI UGC (Seedance, Wan, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway…), is a big plus.

- A sharp eye for detail: the product in the video must look exactly like the real product.

- Fast and consistent work, every day.

- Good written English.

- Your own laptop or PC, stable internet, CapCut on desktop.

- Full-time availability for at least 1 year.



HOW WE HIRE

1. You apply (see below).

2. A paid test task: 3 videos in 1 day, $15. You get paid for the test whether we choose you or not.

3. We tell you within 72 hours if you are selected.

4. A paid trial, then full-time with a contract.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word HOOK in capital letters. We do not read applications without it.

Then send:

1. Links to 2–3 short vertical videos you edited.

2. Links to AI videos you created, if you have any, and which AI tools you used.

3. Confirm that you are OK to start at $500 per month while you learn.

4. Your available working hours and the date you can start.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We build a construction contract and project management platform used by UK Surveying Firms.

What you’ll do

• Test new features, fixes, and releases hands-on, using manual and exploratory testing alongside automation, across the desktop app and web portal

• Build and maintain our automated regression suite in Python (Behave/BDD, page object model), using Selenium for the desktop app and Playwright for the web portal, including desktop-to-portal sync scenarios, and keep it stable by fixing flaky tests

• Automate checks on what matters most to clients: generated documents and exports, data reaching the backend (GraphQL APIs), offline sync, and data separation between clients

• Run regression in CI (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, including overnight runs) and test release branches and hotfixes before they reach clients

Essential

• 5+ years in QA, including 3+ years of test automation, and experience mentoring other testers

• Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, with clear test cases and bug reports

• Strong Python automation with Behave (or another BDD framework), the page object model, and Selenium WebDriver and/or Playwright on complex web applications

• Jira and Xray (or similar), Git (feature branches, rebasing, pull request reviews), and running automated tests in CI





Desirable

• Automating Electron or desktop apps (Chromium remote debugging, pywinauto or similar)

• API testing, ideally GraphQL, and AWS (Amplify, AppSync, DynamoDB, Lambda)

• Security testing, such as script injection and data separation between clients



How we work

We value people who raise concerns directly and constructively, take ownership of their work, and treat

colleagues with respect, whether they’re in QA, development, or leadership.



How to apply

Please attach your CV and a short cover letter explaining why think this would be a good role for you

You must be available to work UK hours.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Hiring

- Follow established workflows, procedures, and documentation guidelines.

- Escalate patient concerns or issues to the appropriate team member when necessary.

- Attend training sessions, team meetings, and coaching sessions.

- Handle other healthcare-related administrative tasks as assigned.



Qualifications

- Strong spoken and written English skills.

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software and computer systems.

- Able to navigate multiple applications and browser tabs efficiently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Able to follow instructions and document information accurately.

- Willing to learn, accept feedback, and improve through coaching.

- Able to work independently while following established procedures.

- Good communication and problem-solving skills.

- Must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, working headset, and quiet workspace.

- Must be available for a full-time schedule aligned with the team's working hours.



Experience in healthcare administration, patient coordination, medical virtual assistance, appointment scheduling, or electronic health records is an advantage.



Six-Week Training and Onboarding



This position includes a structured six-week training and onboarding period covering our systems, workflows, documentation requirements, patient communication, and daily responsibilities.



Full attendance during the first six weeks is extremely important. Each week builds on the previous one, so applicants should only apply if they can commit to the entire training period without planned vacations or avoidable absences.



We understand that genuine emergencies can happen. However, frequent or preventable absences during training can make it difficult to keep up with the material and perform the role successfully.



We invest significant time and effort in training our team members, and we are looking for someone who takes the opportunity seriously, participates actively, asks questions when needed, and applies what they learn.



Work Details

- Position: Patient Care Coordinator

- Employment Type: Full-time

- Work Setup: Remote

- Start Date: Immediate hiring

 How to Apply



Please submit the following as part of your application:



1. Your updated resume.

   - Do you have previous experience in healthcare, patient coordination, or virtual assistance?

We are looking for someone dependable, willing to learn, and committed to supporting our healthcare team. If you meet the requirements and are serious about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: Finance Business Partner – Accounting + FP&A
description:
About MAVI



MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.



Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.



The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.



We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.



The Role



We are seeking a Finance Business Partner to connect the accounting numbers with the people who run the business at a high-growth US company, working remotely from Philippines.



You will partner with department heads on their budgets, forecasts, and spend, and make sure what they plan ties back to what is actually recorded. A strong accounting foundation is what makes the role work: you will support the close for your areas, so your analysis starts from numbers you understand and trust.



What You'll Own



Business Partnering and FP&A

• Budget owners. Act as the finance partner to department heads, helping them plan, track, and explain their spend and headcount.

• Budget and forecast. Build and maintain departmental budgets and the rolling forecast, and feed them into the company plan.

• Variance analysis. Explain budget-versus-actual results each month, with clear root causes and recommended actions.

• Reporting and KPIs. Build reporting packages and dashboards that give leadership a reliable view of performance.



Accounting Support

• Close support. Prepare accruals, prepaids, and reclasses for your areas, and review department-level P&L coding before the close is finalized.

• Spend control. Work with AP and procurement on vendor spend, approvals, and cost allocation.

• Data integrity. Reconcile planning data to the general ledger so forecasts and actuals stay consistent.



What We're Looking For



• 5+ years of experience across accounting and FP&A, with a solid accounting foundation

• Experience building budgets, forecasts, and budget-versus-actual analysis

• Working knowledge of accrual accounting and the month-end close under US GAAP or PFRS or IFRS

• Strong financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets

• Experience working directly with non-finance stakeholders and explaining numbers in plain terms

• Experience with a major ERP or accounting system, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online, or Xero

• Strong written and spoken English for daily work with US teams

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification



Preferred



• Philippine CPA (PRC-licensed), US CPA, ACCA, or equivalent (completed or in progress)

• Experience using AI tools in finance workflows, with the judgment to review and correct AI-generated output

• Experience with planning or BI tools such as Adaptive, Pigment, Mosaic, Power BI, or Looker

• SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including ARR and unit economics

• Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed company



Who This Role Is For



A finance professional who is equally at home in the general ledger and in a budget review, and who would rather help a department head make a better decision than simply report what they spent.



Why Join Through MAVI

• Partner directly with department heads and finance leadership at a high-growth US company

• Build a combined accounting and FP&A profile, the foundation for senior finance roles

• Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll

• USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope

• Progress toward Senior Finance Manager, FP&A Manager, and Finance Manager opportunities through MAVI



Work Arrangement



This is a fully remote role with a single client company for the duration of the engagement. Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET); part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours.

description:
We're a 7-figure/month DTC brand running high-volume paid social across multiple markets. We need ONE elite short-form ad editor who can turn raw UGC and assets into scroll-stopping ads that convert. This is a high-output, performance-driven role — not for generalists or "aesthetic only" editors.

What you'll own:



Editing high-volume short-form video ads (UGC, static-to-video, hook-driven creatives) for Meta and TikTok

Cutting strong hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and motion that drive retention and CTR

Producing multiple ad variations fast — hook tests, angle tests, iterations on winners

Working from briefs and raw creator footage to ship ad-ready assets on tight timelines

Collaborating with the creative/media buying team to iterate based on ad performance data



Who you are:



3+ years editing short-form video specifically for PAID ADS (not just organic/social content)

You understand direct-response: hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, and what makes an ad actually convert

Fast, high-volume, and reliable — you ship a lot without dropping quality

Expert in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut, After Effects a strong plus

You have a proven track record and can SHOW IT — ad examples, results, and ideally performance metrics. No reel, no interview.



Bonus:



Experience with FFmpeg / batch workflows or AI editing tools

Worked with DTC/e-commerce brands at scale

Understanding of Meta ad formats and specs



How to apply:

Send (1) your reel or portfolio of short-form AD work (not wedding videos or vlogs), (2) any performance proof you have — winning ads, results, or campaigns you contributed to, and (3) a short video (60–90 sec) of YOU explaining why you're an A-player for this role and walking us through one ad you've edited and why it works. The video is mandatory — it shows us you can talk hooks, pacing, and direct-response thinking, not just push buttons.



No reel + no application video = no interview. Applications without ad-specific work will be ignored.



A-players only. If you can't edit ads that convert at volume, this role isn't for you.

title: Prior Authorization & Medical Benefits Specialist (Buy and Bill)
description:
About Us

Squad Health provides navigation services and software to US medical practices to remove barriers to treatment — especially prescription access.

Our services include benefits investigation, prior authorization submission, patient assistance enrollment, pharmacy coordination, and patient engagement.

Our tea
mbers operate as extensions of provider offices, supporting clinical staff through accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.



Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Prior Authorization & Medical Benefits Specialist with a strong background in US specialty medication authorizations, including buy-and-bill, infusion, biologic, and clinic-administered medications. This role requires reviewing clinical documentation, verifying medical and pharmacy benefits, submitting medication authorizations, and managing denials and appeals efficiently. This is a fully offshore/remote position, but candidates should have direct, hands-on experience working with US healthcare practices (clinic, infusion center, specialty practice, or buy-and-bill team).



Duties

Verify insurance benefits for drug and procedure orders (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Complete medical benefits investigations for buy-and-bill, infusion, biologic, injectable, and clinic-administered medications

Determine pharmacy vs. medical benefit requirements when applicable

Obtain appropriate authorizations by completing payer-specific forms and clinical questionnaires

Review medical notes, diagnosis information, and treatment history to answer clinical questions accurately

Obtain appropriate authorizations by completing payer-specific forms and clinical questionnaires

Submit and manage authorizations through, payer portals, fax, or phone

Prioritize and manage STAT/urgent requests appropriately

Assist patients with copay assistance or patient assistance programs when needed

Enroll patients into navigation programs and obtain consent

Document all actions clearly in internal systems and case trackers

Participate in tea
etings to resolve patient access challenges and improve workflow



Required Skills & Experience

Minimum 2 years of US-based specialty medication prior authorizations, buy-and-bill, infusion, biologic, or clinic-administered medications

Experience managing a team of buy and bill specialists preferred

Direct experience supporting GI, Dermatology, Rheumatology, Allergy, Oncology, or Urology medication authorizations required

Strong understanding of US insurance plans (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Experience reviewing EMR/EHR clinical documentation

Strong attention to detail and structured documentation habits

Fluent English (written and verbal)

Ability to work without supervision

Ability to work US daytime hours



Application Question(s):

A summary of your relevant experience with US-based buy-and-bill prior authorizations and medical benefits investigations?

List 5 infusion, biologic, or clinic-administered medications for which you have frequently completed buy-and-bill prior authorizations and can discuss during an interview?

Have you worked in a clinic, infusion center, or specialty practice completing buy-and-bill prior authorizations? If so, please elaborate on what payer portals or platforms you used to submit these and verify medical benefits

Why are you looking to leave (or have already left) your previous employer?



Work Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

title: Real Estate Marketing & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Part-Time | Philippines | $6–$8/hour + Performance Bonuses | Long-Term Opportunity



About Our Business



We are a growing real estate investment business specializing in seller-financed properties. We purchase properties, improve them when needed, and offer affordable seller-financing options to qualified buyers.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, proactive Filipino Virtual Assistant who can become an important part of our day-to-day operations.



This is NOT simply a data-entry position.



We want someone who can take ownership of tasks, communicate professionally with potential buyers and contractors, keep our listings and CRM organized, and make sure leads and transactions don't fall through the cracks.



POSITION



Real Estate Marketing & Operations Virtual Assistant



Starting Pay: $6–$8/hour depending on experience and skills



Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours/week to start, with plan to increase hours based on need and performance. 



Schedule: Flexible, but some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be required for communication and follow-up.



Location: Philippines



Employment: long term, part-time with opportunity for additional hours as the business grows



Performance Bonuses: Available for measurable results and exceptional performance.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Real Estate Marketing & Listings — Approximately 35%



You will help keep our properties actively marketed and make sure potential buyers can easily find our available properties.



Responsibilities include:



Create and update property listings on Zillow and other platforms



Create and update
 Marketplace listings



Update property descriptions, photos, pricing and financing terms



Make sure listings contain accurate information



Monitor listing activity and inquiries



Respond promptly to potential buyer inquiries



Help create simple marketing posts and advertisements



Refresh listings when necessary to improve visibility



Track where leads are coming from



Maintain organized property information and photos



Help coordinate marketing campaigns for available properties



Experience with Zillow,
 Marketplace, real estate listings or similar platforms is a BIG plus.



2. Potential Buyer Follow-Up — Approximately 25%



You will help manage incoming potential buyers and make sure leads receive timely follow-up.



Responsibilities include:



Respond to buyer inquiries



Contact potential buyers by phone, text,
 or messaging platforms



Explain basic property information and seller-financing terms



Ask preliminary qualification questions using our established criteria



Follow up with interested buyers who have not completed the next step



Schedule property showings



Confirm showing appointments



Follow up after showings



Keep notes about every significant buyer interaction



Move leads through our CRM



Identify serious prospects and notify the owner



Help maintain a positive and professional experience for potential buyers



You will NOT be expected to make final approval decisions. You will follow our established qualification guidelines and escalate questions or exceptions to the owner.



3. CRM & Lead Management — Approximately 15%



Keeping our CRM accurate will be an important part of this position.



Responsibilities include:



Enter new leads



Update contact information



Record calls, texts,
s and other interactions



Track buyer status



Set follow-up reminders



Follow up on overdue leads



Keep notes organized



Track showing appointments



Track application/qualification status



Make sure no promising lead is forgotten



Provide simple weekly lead reports



We are looking for someone who is VERY organized and naturally follows up without being reminded.



4. Transaction & Administrative Coordination — Approximately 15%



You will also assist with administrative tasks associated with our properties and buyers.



Responsibilities may include:



Help organize documents



Maintain transaction checklists



Follow up with buyers regarding outstanding documents



Help coordinate buyer orientation/onboarding



Prepare information for new buyers using our established procedures



Follow up with contractors regarding estimates, repairs and completion dates



Maintain contractor contact information



Request updates from contractors



Track repair/maintenance projects



Help schedule inspections, contractors and showings



Organize receipts, invoices and other business records



Assist with other administrative tasks as needed



You will be given checklists and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for recurring tasks.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who is:



Reliable — You do what you say you will do.



Organized — You can keep multiple properties, leads and tasks organized without becoming overwhelmed.



Proactive — If you see something that needs to be done, you take action rather than waiting for someone to tell you.



Excellent at follow-up — You understand that following up is one of the most important parts of sales and real estate.



Professional communicator — Your written and spoken English are strong.



Detail-oriented — Small errors in property listings, pricing or buyer information can cause problems.



Comfortable talking to people — You should be comfortable communicating with potential buyers, contractors, agents and other professionals.



Tech-savvy — You learn new software quickly.



Problem solver — When you encounter a problem, you try to find a solution before simply saying, "I don't know."



Honest and trustworthy — You will eventually have access to confidential business information.



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE A BIG PLUS



Please tell us if you have experience with any of the following:



Real estate virtual assistance



Real estate sales



Property management



Zillow



 Marketplace



CRM systems



Lead generation



Buyer follow-up



Appointment setting



Transaction coordination



Contractor coordination



Customer service



Real estate investor businesses



Seller financing



Rent-to-own



Property listings



Canva



Google Workspace



Excel/Google Sheets



Real estate experience is preferred but not absolutely required if you are highly organized, intelligent, proactive and willing to learn.



PERFORMANCE BONUSES



We believe excellent work should be rewarded.



In addition to your hourly pay, there will be opportunities for performance bonuses based on measurable results.



Examples may include:



Qualified potential buyer leads



Successfully scheduled and completed showings



Excellent lead follow-up



Finding qualified prospects



Helping move a buyer through the qualification process



Exceptional listing/marketing performance



Consistently completing tasks accurately and on time



Taking initiative that saves the business significant time or money



Specific bonus amounts and criteria will be explained during the hiring process.



HOURS & GROWTH



We expect approximately 15–20 hours per week initially.



If you are successful, there is an opportunity for:



More hours



Increased responsibility



Higher pay



Additional performance bonuses



Long-term employment



Potential to become a key member of our remote operations team



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with a business, not someone looking for a short-term job.



IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We receive many applications, so we will prioritize candidates who demonstrate that they actually read the job description.



To apply, please answer ALL of the following questions:



1.



Tell us about your previous VA, administrative, customer service, sales or real estate experience.



2.



Have you worked with Zillow,
 Marketplace or other real estate listing platforms? Please explain.



3.



Have you worked with a CRM? If yes, which CRM(s)?



4.



Imagine a potential buyer contacted us about a property but did not respond after our first conversation.



What would you do over the next 7 days to follow up with this person?



5.



A contractor tells you that a repair will be completed "next week," but three days later you have not received an update.



What would you do?



6.



You notice that one of our Zillow listings has incorrect information about the monthly payment.



What would you do?



7.



What hours are you available to work, and what time zone are you in?



8.



Do you have experience making phone calls to customers, buyers, sellers, contractors or businesses?



9.



What computer/software tools are you comfortable using?



10.



Please provide your desired hourly rate.



11.



Please describe a time when you noticed a problem at work and fixed it WITHOUT your manager telling you to do it.



12. SECRET SCREENING QUESTION



At the beginning of your application, write the words "REAL ESTATE ROCKSTAR" so we know you read the entire job posting.



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We want to find the right long-term person rather than simply hire the first applicant.



Our process may include:



Application review



Short video or phone interview



Skills/communication assessment



Short paid practical test



Final interview



Paid trial period



Long-term position for the right person



The practical test will involve realistic tasks such as updating a sample property listing, organizing buyer information, responding to a mock buyer inquiry and creating a follow-up plan.



We are interested in your ability to think, communicate and solve problems—not just your résumé.



FINAL NOTE



If you are dependable, organized, hardworking, comfortable communicating with people, and interested in building a long-term relationship with a growing U.S. real estate business, we would love to hear from you.



We are looking for someone who can eventually become a trusted member of our team and take ownership of important parts of our daily operations.

title: Virtual CIO (vCIO) – Strategic IT Consultant
description:
We are seeking a strategic and business-minded Virtual CIO (vCIO) to serve as a high-level advisor for our diverse portfolio of business clients. In this role, you will act as an extension of our clients' executive teams, bridging the gap between their business goals and their technology infrastructure.



As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

*Strategic IT Roadmapping & Planning

- Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clients to align technology with their 1–3 year business goals.

- Develop and maintain comprehensive IT roadmaps, including hardware lifecycle management, cloud migrations, and

security enhancements.

- Identify emerging technologies that can provide a competitive advantage or operational efficiency for specific client

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Assist clients in developing and managing annual IT budgets.

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

- Oversee client security postures, ensuring alignment with frameworks like NIST, CIS, or industry-specific regulations

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience with ITIL frameworks or MSP-specific vCIO tools.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?



*Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

*Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work while contributing to impactful projects.



How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your IT career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join a team that’s passionate about technology, growth, and delivering exceptional service.



*Submit your application and include the numbers (3000) in your subject line. This helps us ensure you’ve read the full job description.



*Please also attach your updated CV to your application or provide a link to your CV. Applications without a CV will not be considered.



*Currently looking for candidates in NCR or Luzon area of the Philippines



This is an overnight position. The working hours for this role are 8AM-5PM CST Monday to Friday.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Staff Full-Stack Engineer (or Founding Engineer, by seniority)
description:
About ShipStampede

ShipStampede is a multi-carrier shipping platform: we pool discounted parcel rates across UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL and five rate aggregators, and give e-commerce shippers and resellers the software to use them — order import, rate shopping, label purchase, tracking, insurance, wallet billing, and automated carrier-invoice audit. The platform is live in production with paying beta partners, ships to production daily (22 releases in October alone), and is run by a small senior team with no middle layer between engineers and the owner.



The Role

You will be the second platform owner, working beside our lead engineer as a peer — not a ticket-taker under him. You own entire product domains end to end: you write the spec, build the backend and frontend, write the migrations and tests, wire the infrastructure, ship it to production, and own the alarm if it breaks at 2 AM. Today one engineer carries most of this; your job is to make that statement false, starting with the money-handling domains (wallet, billing, carrier-invoice reconciliation, payments).

This is a staff-level role for someone who has already operated this way somewhere else — a founding engineer, a staff engineer at a small company, or the person a 10-person team quietly could not function without.

What You'll Own

• Full-stack features across a 28-module TypeScript monorepo: Express backend running as AWS Lambda, React 18 frontend, PostgreSQL, deployed to production the same week they're specced.

• The money paths: the wallet ledger (holds, captures, refunds, fees), billing and invoicing, the carrier-invoice reconciliation engine (automated detection of carrier overcharges, void variances, billed-never-shipped), and the FloPay card-payment integration.

• Carrier and aggregator integrations: direct UPS/FedEx/USPS REST APIs (OAuth token lifecycles, rating, label purchase, void, tracking webhooks) and aggregator REST APIs, each behind a gateway port with per-service extensions.

• Event-driven plumbing: domain events over AWS EventBridge, a fleet of Lambda workers (scheduled sweeps, webhook processors, reconciliation jobs, print executors), idempotent handlers, outbox patterns, dead-letter queues.

• Infrastructure as code: the Terraform estate (~20 components per environment) covering API Gateway, CloudFront + WAF, RDS + RDS Proxy, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, CloudWatch alarms, Secrets Manager/SSM — across dev, sandbox and prod AWS accounts.

• The full lifecycle: spec documents before code, PRs with tests and screenshots, daily releases through a pinned-RC pipeline, i
 write-ups, and runbooks for what you ship.

Must-Have Experience

7+ years building production web systems, with at least 3 in TypeScript, and prior ownership of money-handling code somewhere real. The exact stack — a strong candidate should recognize most of every row:

Area

Exact skills required

Language & runtime

TypeScript (strict), Node.js 20+, ES modules; Express for HTTP



Architecture

Domain-driven design in a modular monolith: bounded contexts, aggregates and domain events, anti-corruption layers between modules, dependency injection (we use Inversify), Result types over thrown exceptions

Backend patterns

Idempotency keys, optimistic concurrency (version columns, compare-and-set), transactional outbox, saga-style multi-step flows (quote → hold → purchase → capture/refund), event handlers that must never throw

Database

PostgreSQL: schema design across 28 schemas, Knex.js migrations, query performance, row locking, decimal-safe money arithmetic

AWS (serverless)

Lambda (everything deploys as Lambda — no containers), API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS + dead-letter queues, SNS, CloudWatch alarms and logs, S3, RDS Proxy, Secrets Manager/SSM, CloudFront + WAFv2

Infrastructure as code

Terraform: multi-account (dev/sandbox/prod), multi-component state, writing new components from scratch, safe plan/apply discipline

Frontend

React 18 + Vite, TanStack React Query (query-key factories, cache invalidation), React Hook Form + Zod validation, component libraries; you don't need to be a designer, but your UIs ship without one

Monorepo & tooling

pnpm workspaces + Turborepo, Biome, strict CI discipline (type-check ratchets, static analysis gates), Vitest for unit and pg-backed integration tests

Third-party APIs

Hard-won experience integrating messy external REST APIs: OAuth2 client-credential token lifecycles, webhook ingestion with idempotency, rate limiting and retry classification (what you may retry and what you must never), PDF/ZPL label handling a plus

Observability

Sentry instrumentation, structured logging with PII redaction, CloudWatch alarm design, writing the runbook for the thing you built

Beyond the stack, two non-negotiables: you have owned a ledger — you can explain double-entry thinking, why a refund is a new transaction and never an edit, and how you'd find a penny that went missing; and you write — specs before code, honest i
 reports after failures. We are a written-culture team and the interview will include reading something you wrote.

Nice to Have

• Shipping/logistics domain: rate shopping, dimensional weight, zone-based pricing, carrier invoice formats, accessorial surcharges, multi-piece shipments.

• Direct experience with UPS, FedEx or USPS developer APIs, or shipping aggregators (EPS, ShipGrid or similar).

• E-commerce integrations: Shopify Admin API/webhooks, order-import pipelines, CartRover or similar middleware.

• Payment processor integrations (card-present-not-present flows, payment intents, webhook-vs-polling settlement).

• Insurance, claims, or other regulated-money adjacent domains.

• WebSockets for realtime UI, PrintNode or other hardware-printing integrations, Playwright/Puppeteer end-to-end testing.

• Experience being on-call for systems that move money.

How We Work

Every non-trivial change starts as a written spec in the repo, becomes a Linear ticket, ships as a PR against develop with tests and screenshots, and reaches production — often the same day — through a pinned release-candidate pipeline with sandbox QA. CI enforces formatting, static analysis, module-boundary rules and a type-check ratchet; 2,900 test files keep daily releases safe. Engineering rules live in a checked-in handbook with 47 written playbooks covering everything from adding a carrier gateway to cutting a release. There are no standup theatrics and no managers: you talk directly to the owner and to the lead engineer, decisions are written down, and the person who ships a thing owns it in production. Remote, with enough overlap for a daily conversation window with US Pacific and Philippine time.



Interview Signals & Logistics

What we will actually probe for (useful to a recruiter screening candidates):

1. Walk us through a money bug you found and fixed — we want to hear ledger thinking, not framework names.

2. Describe an external API that behaved badly and how your integration survived it — listen for retry classification, idempotency, and "what the customer saw."

3. Show us something you wrote: a spec, a design doc, an i
 report. We read it before the technical interview.

4. A short paid take-home in our stack (TypeScript, Postgres, one messy API) — reviewed as if it were a real PR.

Red flags for this role: needs a product manager to start; frontend-only or backend-only identity; "we had a platform team for the infra"; cannot name a production i
 they personally owned.



Title: Staff Full-Stack Engineer (or Founding Engineer, by seniority). Location: Remote. Compensation: [to be set — market range for this profile is wide by geography; the bar is the skills above, not the zip code]. Reports to: the owner, working day-to-day with the lead engineer.

title: Experienced Removals Sales & Booking Agent (for Moving Services)
description:
Previous experience in the removals / moving services industry is MANDATORY. 



Are you the kind of sales professional who can take a “How much will my move cost?” enquiry and turn it into a confirmed booking?



Have you previously worked in sales and bookings for a removals or moving company handling domestic or commercial moves, a man-and-van service, or an office relocation provider?



If you know how to quote moving jobs, handle price objections, and close bookings confidently, we want to hear from you!



We are a UK-based removals and relocation services company serving customers across London, hiring experienced full-time remote Removals Sales & Booking Agents based in the Philippines.



Your main priority is simple: convert inbound enquiries into confirmed removals bookings quickly, accurately, and professionally.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENT: Previous Removals Industry Experience



We are only considering candidates who have previous hands-on sales and booking experience in the removals / moving industry, including services such as:



House and apartment removals



Man and van services



Home moving and furniture transportation



Office and commercial relocations



Related removal and relocation services



Experience in the removals industry from any country is welcome. Previous UK market experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.



You must understand how removals enquiries are handled, how to gather the information needed for accurate quotations, and how to turn price enquiries into confirmed moving bookings.



General call centre, customer support, or sales experience alone is NOT sufficient without relevant removals industry experience.



What Success Looks Like



You confidently turn inbound calls and messages into confirmed bookings.



You know how to qualify removals enquiries and provide accurate quotes.



You handle price objections, customer hesitation, and competitor comparisons effectively.



You follow up on warm leads and unconfirmed quotations to maximise conversions.



You consistently meet booking and sales performance targets.



Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities



Answer inbound calls, messages, and customer enquiries about moving and removals services.



Gather essential moving details: collection and delivery postcodes, inventory, property size, floors, stairs, lift access, parking, moving dates, and special requirements.



Prepare accurate quotations using our pricing guidelines.



Convert enquiries into confirmed removals and man-and-van bookings.



Handle objections and negotiate confidently within company guidelines.



Follow up on missed calls, open quotations, and potential bookings.



Maintain accurate customer records, booking details, and follow-up notes.



What We're Looking For



Mandatory: Previous sales and booking experience with a removals, moving, or relocation services company.



Minimum 2–3 years of call centre or phone-based customer sales experience.



Proven ability to close sales and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.



Familiarity with removals quoting, moving inventories, access requirements, and booking procedures.



Excellent spoken and written English with a clear and professional telephone manner.



Strong objection-handling, negotiation, and follow-up skills.



Results-driven attitude with a focus on conversion rates and confirmed bookings.



Reliable attendance, punctuality, and consistent performance.



Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.



Stable internet connection and a reliable remote working setup.



This is a Full-time remote position -that aligns with Philippine night shift, aligned with UK business hours



Training



Training will be provided on our specific services, pricing structure, quoting guidelines, booking systems, and internal procedures.



Please note: This training is designed for candidates who already understand the removals and moving services industry. It is not intended as introductory training for applicants without relevant industry experience.



How to Apply



Important: Start your application with the word "removals".



Please send: Your updated CV/resume.



A short introduction (1–2 paragraphs) explaining your previous experience in removals sales and bookings. Specify the removals or moving companies you worked for, the services you handled, and your responsibilities in quoting and closing bookings.



Details of your sales performance, such as average monthly bookings or conversion rates, if available.



A link to a short English voice recording or introduction video demonstrating your communication skills.



Applications without relevant previous removals sales and booking experience will not be considered.



We are looking for experienced booking closers who understand the removals industry and can start converting enquiries into confirmed jobs.
