title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Using SEO data to make content decisions.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms in professional SEO or content workflows.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



Local SEO Knowledge

Candidates should have strong working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page strategy.

-City and location-page strategy.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local content architecture and service-to-location relationships.

-Local competitor and SERP analysis.

-Determining when location-specific pages are justified by search intent and business needs.

-Avoiding thin, duplicate, templated, or doorway-style local pages.

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

-Content prioritization.

-Google Search Console data.

-Modern search behavior and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable.



AI & Claude Experience

AI is an important part of how our team works. We are particularly interested in candidates who know how to use AI for more than simply generating content.

You should be comfortable using AI to assist with:



-Research and analysis.

-Local and organic content-gap identification.

-Competitor and SERP analysis.

-Content strategy and prioritization.

-Service and location content planning.

-Content briefs.

-SEO analysis.

-Reviewing and improving existing content.

-Identifying entity, topic, and question-coverage opportunities.

-Developing repeatable workflows.



Experience using Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, or other structured/reusable AI workflows is a strong advantage but is not required.



We can teach our specific systems to someone with excellent SEO/content strategy skills who can learn sophisticated AI workflows.



AI Search Visibility

We also want this person to understand how search is evolving beyond traditional organic rankings.



The strategist should be able to consider how content can improve visibility across Google AI experiences and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.



This includes thinking about entity clarity, topical coverage, question coverage, authoritative supporting content, and how local businesses and their services, locations, and expertise are represented across the web.



AI search knowledge is important, but it does not replace strong traditional and Local SEO fundamentals.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:



-Thinks strategically rather than simply completing tasks.

-Has strong Local SEO instincts as well as broader organic SEO knowledge.

-Can determine whether a local content opportunity actually deserves a dedicated page.

-Can explain the reasoning behind recommendations.

-Has strong professional content writing and editing experience and can recognize excellent versus mediocre content.

-Can independently improve content to a publication-ready standard when needed.

-Is highly analytical.

-Has strong attention to detail.

-Can work independently.

-Follows instructions carefully.

-Communicates clearly.

-Is comfortable learning new technology and workflows.

-Understands that AI should enhance strategic thinking rather than replace it.

-Can identify opportunities rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Position Details

Position: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search

Schedule: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time

Location: Remote - Worldwide

Compensation: Competitive compensation based on experience, demonstrated skill level, and geographic market.



Candidates must be able to consistently work the required Eastern Time schedule.



This is not a freelance or part-time opportunity. We are hiring someone to work full-time as part of our team.



Application Process

Applications submitted through the job platform alone will not be considered.

To apply, you must complete our application form:



The application includes questions about your SEO, Local SEO, digital marketing agency, content strategy, writing/editing, and AI experience and requires a short video introduction.



Candidates who successfully complete the initial application process may be invited to complete a practical assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the position, including Local SEO content strategy, broader SEO strategy, and content writing/editing judgment.



Hiring Process

Application + Video → Initial Review → Practical Assessment → Team Review → Interview → Final Evaluation

We use this process to evaluate practical ability, Local SEO and organic SEO strategy, content writing and editing ability, strategic thinking, communication, attention to detail, and overall fit for the position.



Please do not apply unless you are willing to complete the full application process and can consistently work 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time.

title: Become a Top Performance Creative at an 8-Figure DTC Brand | Video Editor, $1,500–$2,500/mo
description:
We're an 8-figure brand, the ads are working, and now we need more of them than our team can make. So we're hiring a DTC Video Editor.



But this isn't just another editing job.



At most places, you get a brief, make the ad, and send it off. And then nothing.



You never see the numbers. Nobody tells you why one ad printed for months while another died on day two. You're good, but nobody around you is making you better.



Here, that changes.



Who we are

We're an 8-figure brand scaling fast. We run all types of ad concepts, AI VO + B-roll, Founder, Statics, Ai Animations, Podcasts, Natives. We've tested it all with real spend and we know what converts.



We're not looking for someone to push buttons. We're looking for someone who wants to become one of the best creatives in performance advertising.



What you get here

→ Work directly with our creative strategists. No layers of managers

→ Weekly sessions in the ad account: what won, what died, and why

→ Learn the strategy behind the ads, not just the editing. What takes most editors years, you'll pick up in months

→ Room to grow. Start as an editor, take on more strategy, and your pay grows with it



Who this is for

→ You've edited ads for DTC brands and know what a scroll-stopping hook looks like

→ You're comfortable using AI tools (voice, image and video gen) to level up your edits

→ You're always asking "why did that one work?"



The details

→ $1,500–$2,500/month base, depending on experience

→ Full time, remote, tracked 8 hours/day



This isn't for everyone



If you need think you are making ads for them to look nice, this won't fit.



But if you're hungry to get better and want to work on ads that actually scale, we want to hear from you.



To apply, send me:

→ The DTC brands you've worked with

→ Your portfolio

→ A short intro on who you are (extra points if it's a Loom)

You should be comfortable with Adobe Premiere Pro or basic CapCut editing, though all workflows and templates will be clearly explained. The most important qualities for this role are consistency, responsibility, and the ability to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines.



Responsibilities

* Edit videos in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut using provided assets and instructions.

* Generate or apply AI voiceovers (tutorials provided; prior experience is a strong advantage).

* Maintain and update a content calendar in Google Sheets to keep production on schedule.

* Organize projects, assets, and timelines for multiple videos simultaneously.

* Ensure all videos are completed at least one day before their scheduled publishing date.

* Assist with general AI or media-related tasks, such as image generation or voice creation.



Requirements

* Basic proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut, or willingness to learn quickly.

* Ability to manage several video projects at once while maintaining quality.

* Familiarity with AI tools (AI voice, Claude, ChatGPT) or willingness to learn.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to track tasks through Google Sheets.

* Reliable adherence to deadlines; consistency is essential.

* A computer capable of smooth video editing and exporting.

* Good communication skills and the ability to follow step-by-step tutorials.



Work Hours and Benefits

* Approximately 5–6 hours per day during the learning period.

* Once the workflow is mastered, the workload will typically be around 4 hours per day or less.

* Flexible schedule; work at your preferred time as long as deadlines are met.

* All required software and tools will be provided.

* Performance bonuses available for:

 * Meeting deadlines consistently

 * Maintaining excellent communication

 * Delivering high-quality work across multiple projects



Work Culture

This is a friendly and collaborative work environment with no strict corporate pressure. If something is unclear, you are encouraged to ask. The primary goal is to keep the content calendar on track and ensure videos are delivered and scheduled consistently. All other processes can be adjusted as we work together.



How to Apply

If you have read this posting carefully, please include the number 3 in your application message.

Please also provide:

 * A link to your portfolio or sample work

 * A brief description of your experience with Premiere Pro, CapCut, and any AI tools

title: YouTube Operations Manager (Multi-Channel, AI-Driven) — Full-Time
description:
Hi there!

We run a fast-growing network of ~20 YouTube channels and produce videos at scale. We’re hiring a hands-on Operations/Channel Manager to run the daily pipeline end-to-end: plan, assign, QA, publish, and report. You’ll be the first line of support for the team and solve problems before they reach the owner.



What You’ll Do

 • Own the production calendar & quotas across multiple channels; run quick daily check-ins; assign tasks; keep everything scheduled 1+ day in advance.

 • Lead and coach the team (editors, thumbnail designers, uploaders, script/voice). Handle hiring, onboarding, training, performance follow-ups.

 • Build and maintain SOPs, templates, prompts, and asset libraries (PSD/CapCut/Premiere presets, brand kits).

 • Ideation: create weekly lists of video ideas and title options per channel using simple frameworks (we’ll teach you), competitor scans, and ChatGPT; turn approved ideas into clear briefs.

 • Quality control: titles, thumbnails, pacing, captions, metadata; ensure output is error-free and on time.

 • Prepare simple assets for the team when needed (text edits in Photoshop, export presets in CapCut/Premiere).

 • Reporting in Google Sheets: trackers for tasks, on-time status, rework notes; share concise weekly summaries.

 • Unblock and escalate smartly: resolve day-to-day issues yourself; escalate only decisions that truly need the owner.



Requirements

 • Proven team leadership (remote creative teams). Tell us team size, roles, and what you owned (planning, QA, training).

 • Google Sheets: comfortable building trackers, checklists, and simple dashboards.

 • ChatGPT: strong practical skills for briefs, titles, checklists, SOP drafts, troubleshooting.

 • YouTube ideation: experience brainstorming content ideas and turning them into clear, executable briefs (we’ll refine your process).

 • Working knowledge of YouTube Studio (uploading, metadata, scheduling).

 • Basic hands-on with CapCut and Premiere Pro (trim/sequence, captions, export presets).

 • Basic Photoshop (text edits in PSD templates, export).

 • Excellent written English, proactive problem-solver, reliable with deadlines.

 • Able to overlap at least 2 hours daily with CET for quick alignment.



Nice to Have

 • Process documentation (Loom + SOPs), light automations (Zapier/Apps Script/ClickUp/Notion).

 • Basic understanding of A/B testing principles for titles/thumbnails (not required).



Work Hours & Benefits

 • Full-time, Mon–Fri, flexible hours with daily presence during agreed overlap.

 • Tools provided; performance bonuses for smooth ops and dependable delivery.

 • Paid test week to ensure mutual fit.



How to Apply

 1. Leadership summary – describe teams you’ve led (size, roles) and your responsibilities (hiring, onboarding, SOPs, QA, planning).

 2. Content ops experience – which pipelines you ran (YouTube or similar), your day-to-day, and tools you used.

 3. Share a simple Google Sheets sample (screenshot or view-only link with sanitized data) showing how you track tasks/progress.

 4. Ideation sample – provide 5–10 video ideas with draft titles for any niche you know; add 1–2 sentences per idea explaining the angle.

 5. Skill self-ratings (1–10): Google Sheets, ChatGPT, YouTube Studio, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop.

 6. Send a short 1–2 min Loom “about you” — who you are, how you communicate with the team, how you solve problems, and which tools you use.



Note: No need to share client channel links or sensitive work.

title: YouTube Upload Assistant – Part-Time, Paid Per Video (Fast Internet Required)
description:
We run an upload service for YouTube creators. The videos are already finished: you don't edit, write or design anything. You download the video, take the title, description and thumbnail we give you, and upload it in YouTube Studio by hand.



WHAT YOU DO

- Open your personal queue page. Every video has its own card with the video file, the thumbnail, the title, the description, the settings and the exact time it should go live.

- Download the video and the thumbnail.

- Upload it in YouTube Studio, paste the title and description, add the thumbnail, set the options from the card and schedule it for the time on the card.

- Paste the video link back on the card and press Done.

- At the start: about 10 videos a day. More as we add channels.



HOW ACCESS WORKS

- You never get a password and never log in to anyone's Google account. You work in prepared browser profiles (Multilogin) that we give you access to.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Internet of at least 100 Mbps download AND 100 Mbps upload (fiber). The video files are big, so this is a must.

- A computer (Windows or Mac) you can use for this work.

- Experience with YouTube Studio (uploading, scheduling, thumbnails) is a big plus.

- Good English reading and a careful eye: right channel, right title, right time, every time.

- Reliability: videos must go out on time, every day. We agree on a fixed time slot with you.



PAY

- $0.20 per video you upload.

- 10 videos a day = about $60 a month to start. One video takes about 5-7 minutes of your time.

- Paid every two weeks via Wise.

- It grows with you: more channels, more videos, more pay.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "FAST UPLOAD" so we know you read this. Then send:

1. A speed test screenshot from speedtest.net (download and upload)

2. Your time zone and the hours you can work

3. Have you used YouTube Studio before? What did you upload?

4. One sentence: what do you do if YouTube Studio shows a different channel than the one on the card?

Recommend opportunities based on relevance, qualification requirements, potential value, and likelihood of successful execution.



Identify gaps in our current government contracting process and suggest practical improvements.

Hands-on experience with 
 and government solicitation research.

Initial priorities include:



Review our existing GSA contracting position and identify the information needed to pursue opportunities.



Identify relevant federal, state, and municipal procurement sources.



Build a targeted pipeline of qualified contracting opportunities.



Establish a tracking system for opportunities, deadlines, bids, and outcomes.



Recommend which opportunities management should prioritize.



Help coordinate bid submissions and follow-ups once opportunities are approved internally.



Performance will be evaluated based on the relevance and quality of opportunities identified, accuracy of tracking, deadline management, quality of bid support, and progress toward building a sustainable government contracting pipeline.

Identify deals that meet our investment criteria.

Help the company consistently secure profitable property deals.

Be part of a fast-growing property investment business.

Most editors cut what they're handed, send it off, and never find out. You get a brief you didn't write, for a hook you'd have done differently, and nobody tells you the result. If you only want to be handed a brief and cut it, stop here. This isn't that.



You'd be cutting for a Dubai performance creative agency working with fast-growing ecommerce and health brands on Meta and TikTok. The founders built and sold a 7-figure ecommerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. They run on AI and they move fast. Ally is hiring on their behalf.



---

The job



- Cut fast-paced DR ads: VSLs, UGC and creator cuts, hook stacks, AI UGC, AI explainers, animated.



- Use AI tools (avatars, voice, AI b-roll, image-to-video) to make formats a normal editor can't.



- Bring your own hooks, structures and visual concepts. They want your brain, not only your hands.



---



Your first 30 days



- You get put through intensive training. Their own courses, daily calls with the founders, feedback on everything you make, and you start writing hooks, briefs and scripts yourself.



- By the end of it you're not an editor. You're a Creative Producer.



- That means you d
 what ad gets made and why, you write the hook and the brief, you get it produced, and you read the numbers afterwards to d
 what comes next.



- And it doesn't stop there. The role grows into leading creative operations and delivery.



---



The money



$3,500 to $5,000 USD a month depending on experience, plus bonuses when your ads become winners.



It's a high number because this is three jobs in one. The craft, the AI stack, and the judgment to know why an ad converts. Most editors have one of those. A few have two.



We're hiring one person for this role now. Ally places senior editors with growing ecommerce and health brands regularly, so if you're strong and this particular one isn't the fit, we'll come to you first when the next opens.



---



You're a fit if



- 3+ years editing paid social ads, ideally ecommerce, DR, supplements, info products or affiliates



- You can show ads that actually ran



- You've made AI UGC, AI avatar or AI-generated ads. We'll ask which tools and what they replaced



- You've picked up a new AI tool in the last few months and it changed what you can make



- Multiple ads a day doesn't scare you



- Your English is strong enough to follow scripts precisely



- You can give at least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time



---



You're not a fit if



- Your portfolio is mostly brand films, weddings or vlogs



- You only want to edit and never think about why an ad works



- You need days to turn around one ad



---



How to apply

Fill out the form: 



Record a 2 to 3 minute Loom. Pick one ad you edited that actually ran and walk us through it. 

What was the hook, and why that structure? What did you d
 yourself, and what was handed to you in the brief? How long did it run, or roughly what did it spend, if you know? What would you change now?



No Loom, no review. We watch every one.



We review every application within two working days and we reply either way.



----



About Ally



We place full-time people with founders and small teams, and we stay with you after you start: goals, reviews and growth, not just an introduction. We currently support people working with founders across Hong Kong, Dubai, the UK and Japan.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start email marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take email marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

title: Seller Discovery Specialist, US Real Estate (Natural American Accent)
description:
Wage: $900 to $1,060/month base + bonus for every closed contract

Hours: 40/week, 8 AM to 5 PM US Eastern (8 PM to 5 AM Manila), some weekend mornings



We are a Georgia home-buying company (since 2017, 1,000+ houses bought, A+ BBB accredited, Google 4.5 Stars). Homeowners contact us because something in their life is forcing a decision: an inherited house, a divorce, a parent moving to care, payments they can't keep up with.



OUR LEADS ARE ALL HOT/WARM NEVER COLD! No cold calling, no cold texting!

We pay for our leads and they come in as soon as the person fills out the webform, its your job to call them back and get them to engage with you.



Your job is the first real conversation. You call the seller within minutes, get them comfortable, and learn their story: why they want to sell, what happens if nothing changes, who else is on the deed, what they owe, and what shape the house is in. Then you book a callback with the owner, who makes the offer. You never talk price.



You are a fit if:

- People open up to you. Strangers tell you their story within five minutes.

- Your English sounds natural to American homeowners. We test this with a recording.

- You follow up like it's your job, because it is. No callback falls through the cracks.

- You already use Claude (Anthropic's AI) every day, not just ChatGPT.

- Salesforce or other CRM experience



What you'll do daily:

- Call new seller leads within 60 seconds during your shift

- Run discovery calls (15 to 25 minutes) and book the owner's offer call with every decision maker on it

- Re-engage sellers who missed appointments, by phone, text and

- Use Claude to log calls into Salesforce, prep comps, and draft follow-up texts and
s



Nice to have: US real estate, appointment setting for US clients, Sandler Sales Training or Chris Voss training.



To apply,
 (do not just click Apply):

Subject line: PEACH-1 [your full name]



Record ONE unlisted YouTube video, 3 minutes max, one take, no edits, music or filters. Talk like you're on the phone with a homeowner, not presenting to an employer.



Part 1 (about 30 seconds). Read this out loud like you're calling a seller:

"Hi, is this Linda? Hey Linda, this is [your first name] with Property Problem Solvers. You filled out a request about the house on Maple Street, did I catch you at a bad time? Great. I'll be quick. I just want to hear a little about the house and what's going on, and if it looks like something we can help with, the owner will call you back with an offer. And if it's not a fit, that's totally okay, you can just tell me no. Fair enough?"



Part 2 (about 45 seconds). The seller says: "Look, I don't have time for twenty questions. Just tell me what you'll pay." Answer in your own words. Do NOT give a price.



Part 3 (about 20 seconds). Leave a voi
 for a seller named James who missed his 2 PM call with us today.



Part 4 (about 60 seconds). Screen-record yourself doing a real task in Claude and talk us through it. Blur anything private.



In the body of your
: your available hours in US Eastern time and your backup internet and power plan.



Applications without the subject code or the video are not reviewed.

title: Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Supplements)
description:
Creative Strategist (Meta Ads, DTC Supplements)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: DOE (depends on experience), with a clear path to salary increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. You'll work directly with Matt, ABG Media's CMO and founder (10+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience), and get trained in the systems we use to grow brands.



Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and work across more ABG client accounts as we grow. For our brands, creative is the biggest growth lever there is.



The customers our brands serve are real people with real problems: women going through menopause, people trying to lose weight, people who can't sleep, people tired of products full of chemicals they can't pronounce. They've tried everything else. Our ads need to speak to them honestly and give them a reason to try something clean.



Role Overview

The Creative Strategist is the brain of our creative engine. You d
 what we test and why. You'll dig into customer reviews, competitor ads, and our clients' Meta data to find the angles, hooks, and avatars that turn scrollers into buyers. Then you'll turn those ideas into clear briefs and scripts for our video editor, static designer, and UGC creators.



You'll work directly with our media buyer, video editor, static designer, and creator manager. You will own the creative pipeline for every account you work on, and that means making sure it never runs dry.



We're an AI-forward team. We expect you to use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, production, and iteration: ChatGPT/Claude for review mining, competitor research, angles, and first-draft copy and scripts; Midjourney/ChatGPT Images for quick static concepts and mockups; and an understanding of what Kling/Runway/Higgsfield can do for AI video so you can brief it. AI multiplies your output, but your human judgment owns the strategy and compliance.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Strategy & Research

- Own the angles, hooks, customer avatars, and messaging for every client product we advertise.

- Mine customer reviews, Amazon reviews, Reddit, TikTok, comment sections, and the Meta Ad Library for customer language, pain points, objections, and buying triggers.

- Build and maintain an avatar and angle library for each client brand and product (starting with our current client's hormone balance, weight/gut/detox, sleep, pain relief, and skin and hair lines).

- Spot new formats and trends before they get saturated, and adapt them to each brand.



Briefs & Scripts

- Write 18-25 creative briefs per week across static ads, UGC, and edited video ads, using AI to speed up research, hook generation, and drafts.

- Write UGC and voiceover scripts with multiple hook options for each concept.

- Define the headline, hook, visual direction, footage/shot needs, CTA, and references in every brief, clear enough that the team can execute without a back-and-forth.

- Brief our creator manager on what creators need to film and say.

- Review finished creatives before launch and give specific, actionable feedback.



Performance Analysis

- Analyze Meta creative performance weekly for each account: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and AOV.

- Break down what is working and why, by angle, hook, format, avatar, and offer.

- Spot fatigue early and plan iterations of winners (new hooks, new formats, new sizes) before they die.

- Send a short weekly creative report: what won, what lost, what we learned, and what's next.



Collaboration & Workflow

- Work closely with the media buyer on what to test next and how to structure tests.

- Lead a weekly creative review with the editor, designer, and creator manager.

- Keep our briefs, creative tracker, and testing pipeline organized and up to date.



Compliance

- Make sure every concept and script is safe for supplement advertising. No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, no exaggerated promises, and nothing that breaks Meta's health and wellness ad policies. Example: we never say a product "cures," "treats," or "prevents" a condition. You need to know how to write ads that convert without crossing that line.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years of creative strategy for DTC paid social (Meta required).

- Real ads you briefed or scripted, with results you can show or talk through (spend, ROAS, CPA, hook rate, or anything else you tracked).

- Strong grasp of direct response fundamentals and buyer psychology.

- Ability to think in angles and avatars, not just visuals.

- Experience writing briefs and scripts for designers, editors, and UGC creators.

- Comfortable reading Meta Ads Manager data and turning it into decisions.

- Excellent written English and clear spoken English for calls and Loom videos.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.

- Daily, hands-on use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, or similar) for research, scripting, and concept mockups.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- Experience with compliance-sensitive categories.

- UGC creator sourcing or management experience.

- Familiar with tools like Motion, Foreplay, Triple Whale, Shopify, or Amazon.

- Basic editing or design skills (CapCut, Canva, Figma) for rough mockups.



What Matters Most To Us: Work Ethic and Ownership

We'll be direct: work ethic and ownership matter more to us than anything else on this list. We want someone who treats every client brand like it's their own. That means:

- You don't wait to be told what to test next. You come with the plan.

- When an ad flops, you dig into why and fix it without making excuses.

- When the pipeline is empty, you fill it.

- You hit your deadlines and communicate early when something is off.

- You care about the result (sales), not just finishing the task.

If you want a role where you get told exactly what to do every day, this isn't it. If you want to own the creative for fast-growing DTC brands and grow with us, keep reading.



What We're Looking For

- Data-driven but creative

- Obsessed with testing, learning, and iterating

- Fast, organized, and reliable

- Comfortable producing 18-25 briefs per week

- Strong communicator and team player



What We Offer

- Salary DOE (depends on experience), with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our creative strategy and direct response systems

- Work directly with the CMO (10+ years in ecommerce), not a middle manager

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Your ideas get tested fast

- Real ownership over the creative direction of the brand

- Room to grow into a Head of Creative role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN ANGLES" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've worked on, and your current role.

2. 2-3 examples of real ads you briefed or scripted, with the results (links, screenshots, or a short description of the numbers).

3. REQUIRED SAMPLE: 3 angle ideas for one product from any DTC supplement or wellness brand of your choice. For each angle, include:

   - Target avatar (who it's for)

   - The angle (the core idea / reason to buy)

   - 1-2 hook lines

   - Suggested format (static, UGC, voiceover video, etc.)

   Keep it supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

4. Confirm that the starting pay, DOE (depends on experience), works for you.

title: Senior Operations & Customer Experience Manager
description:
Company: Pawkit Pte. Ltd. (Singapore)

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: PHP 90,000–120,000/month, depending on experience



About Pawkit

Pawkit is a Singapore-based pet technology company making professional pet care more accessible and convenient. Through our platform, we connect pet owners with trusted professionals for veterinary services, grooming, nursing, pet sitting, and other pet care services delivered to their doorstep.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior Operations & Customer Experience Manager to lead our daily operations, manage our team, and build efficient, scalable processes.



Key Responsibilities

> Operations & Customer Experience

- Oversee daily operations, customer service, bookings, and service coordination.

- Ensure smooth service delivery and consistently high customer satisfaction.

- Independently resolve operational challenges, escalations, and service issues.

- Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to operational efficiency.



> People Management & HR

- Lead and manage a distributed team across Singapore, the Philippines, and Vietnam.

- Oversee staff scheduling, attendance, leave planning, and workforce allocation.

- Conduct performance reviews, coaching, onboarding, and training.

- Address underperformance, reinforce accountability, and build a high-performing team.

- Support recruitment, HR administration, and implementation of company policies.



> SOPs & Process Improvement

- Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs.

- Establish clear workflows, responsibilities, and quality control measures.

- Identify opportunities for automation and collaborate with the technical team to improve systems.

- Ensure consistent adherence to company policies and operational standards.



> Performance & Reporting

- Establish and monitor KPIs for operational efficiency, service quality, and team performance.

- Analyse operational data, identify trends, and implement corrective actions.

- Provide regular performance reports and actionable recommendations to management.

- Take ownership of operational outcomes and drive continuous improvement.



> Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in operations management, including at least 3 years managing teams.

- Proven experience managing remote or cross-functional teams.

- Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

- Demonstrated success in developing SOPs, improving workflows, and managing team performance.

- Comfortable working with CRM systems, operational dashboards, spreadsheets, and digital tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Highly organised, analytical, proactive, and capable of working independently.

- Experience in service-based businesses, healthcare, veterinary services, logistics, or technology-enabled operations is an advantage.



> Who We're Looking For

- We're looking for someone who takes ownership rather than waits for instructions.

- You should be comfortable making decisions, holding people accountable, identifying problems before they escalate, and developing practical solutions.

- This is not a role focused solely on supervising customer service agents. We're looking for someone who can build systems, develop people, and take responsibility for running the day-to-day operations of a growing company.



> What We Offer

- Competitive salary based on experience.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Significant autonomy and ownership over operational decisions.

- Opportunity to grow into a Head of Operations position as the company expands.



> How to Apply

- Please submit your CV and a brief introduction highlighting:



1. The largest team you've managed and your scope of responsibility.

2. An operational process you've personally improved, including measurable results.

3. An example of a difficult people-management or operational challenge you've independently resolved.

Optimise CAC, CPA, ROAS and conversion rates to drive profitable customer acquisition.

Monitor campaign profitability, customer acquisition costs and customer lifetime value.

Optimise website content and landing pages to improve search visibility and conversions.

Monitor performance using Google Search Console and SEO tools.



4. CRM,
 Marketing & Retention

 marketing, customer segmentation and reactivation campaigns.

Identify opportunities to increase customer lifetime value.

Conduct competitor research and marketing experiments.

Collaborate with our Content Creator on performance-driven campaigns and creative briefs.

Present weekly performance reports, insights and actionable recommendations.



Requirements

Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in performance or growth marketing.

Proven experience independently managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Working knowledge of SEO,
 marketing and CRM automation.

The pace is fast: we run 50+ ad assets per week and we need someone who can match that without dropping quality.



If you’re obsessed with what makes ads stop the scroll, passionate about plants and home gardening, and you get genuinely excited reading through a Meta ad library — this role is for you.



Responsibilities



Develop creative concepts and hooks for Meta ads across static, video, and long-form text formats

Study Meta ad libraries regularly — competitor brands, trending formats, winning angles — and bring those learnings into our creative strategy

Review raw footage and identify the visual hooks worth building around

Write fast, clear creative briefs for video editors — angle, hook, structure, reference — keeping the production pipeline moving

Give direct feedback on edits and iterate quickly

Produce quick-turn assets yourself using CapCut or similar tools when needed

Stay on top of trends in the plant, home, and lifestyle space — specifically what resonates with millennial women in the US



Requirements



Proven Meta ad creative experience for a US or Australian brand — you can show us campaigns you worked on and the results

Strong hook-writing ability — you find angles that are specific, surprising, and tailored to the audience

Comfortable reading and analysing Meta ad libraries as part of your weekly workflow

Able to produce and brief 50+ ad assets per week — you work fast and you thrive under volume

Proficient in CapCut or similar editing tools for quick-turn asset production

Familiar with AI tools for image generation and creative ideation (Midjourney, Runway, or similar)

Experience targeting millennial women — you understand what resonates with this audience

Genuine passion for plants and gardening



Nice to Have



Experience with long-form text-style ads

Familiarity with UGC platforms like Trybe or Insense



Job Details



Full-time, remote

Must have at least 5 hours overlap with Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT) — US hours are not required

Competitive salary for the right candidate — please include your expected rate when applying



To Apply

Send us your portfolio or examples of Meta ad creative you’ve developed, along with a brief note on why you’re a great fit. Applicants without portfolio examples will not be considered.

/



What You’ll Own



You’ll own the schedule and the output for each channel. Our team will guide strategy, supply specialist input and review your work.



Social Media

Draft and schedule one AEK Media post each week, plus regular LinkedIn posts for our Sales Manager and CEO. Check comments on all of these posts, reply where appropriate and flag anything that needs our attention.



Video Content

Coordinate one batch of around four videos each month. Plan the topics, book the shoot with our video team, follow up on edits and schedule the finished videos.



Articles and Service Pages

Draft one article and one service page each month from an SEO brief, using AI tools such as Claude. Work with our SEO team on reviews, then build and publish them.



 Marketing

Build, test and send one
 to each list every month in HubSpot. Keep contact lists clean and organised.



 Outreach

Run one outreach campaign each month. Find prospects using our process, review their websites for specific marketing issues and write personalised
s based on what you find. Log all activity in HubSpot and pass warm replies to our Sales Manager.



Case Studies

Deliver one case study each week. Gather results and details from our account managers, draft the case study, review it with us and build it.



Weekly Enquiry Report

Track how many new quality enquiries AEK receives each week and report on the trend every Monday.



Weekly Scorecard

Keep a simple scorecard showing each target against what was delivered, and bring it to a weekly check-in with your manager.



About You



1+ years of hands-on marketing experience, ideally in content, social media or
 marketing.

You are highly organised and can keep several weekly and monthly deadlines on track without reminders.

You are comfortable following up with busy people, politely and persistently, to get what you need.

You write clear, natural English and can draft content that sounds like a real person wrote it.

You have strong attention to detail. You notice typos, broken links, incorrect figures and small problems before they go live.

You can look at a website and spot what is holding its marketing back.

You are comfortable using AI tools to draft and research, and you know their output still needs checking.

You are proactive. If something is behind or looks wrong, you raise it and suggest a fix rather than waiting to be asked.

Highly Regarded



Experience with HubSpot
 campaigns or CRM

Experience with cold
 outreach or B2B lead generation

Experience writing or publishing website content

Experience with social scheduling tools

WordPress or Elementor experience

Experience in a marketing agency

Basic understanding of SEO

Experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools for marketing work



Why AEK Media?



Work remotely with a globally recognised, award-winning team.

Learn across social, video, content, SEO,
 and outreach, with training and support from experienced marketers.

Take on more responsibility as your skills grow, with genuine opportunities for career progression.

Join a culture that values transparency, merit and action.



Our Values



No Black Boxes: Transparency in all we do

Do Things Today, Not Tomorrow: Take action and keep things moving

Open Forum: Good ideas can come from anyone

Don’t Avoid the Details: The small things often make the biggest difference

Consider the Commercial: Marketing needs to deliver meaningful business outcomes



How to Apply



We welcome applications from people who don’t meet every requirement. We care more about how you think and how reliable you are than a perfect CV.



Along with your CV, please include brief answers to the following:



Which marketing tools have you used hands-on (e.g. HubSpot, Canva, WordPress, social scheduling tools)?

Tell us about a time you managed several deadlines at once. How did you keep everything on track?

You need information from a busy colleague for a case study, and they haven’t replied in three days. What do you do?

Pick any small Australian business website. What is one marketing issue you can see, and how would you explain it to the owner in two sentences?

How have you used AI tools in your marketing work, and how do you check what they produce?

Which areas of marketing do you want to develop over the next two years?

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Market Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned



The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.



During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.



Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.



Responsibilities:

1. If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

• Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application

• Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and d
 who advances

• Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections

• Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared

• Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip

• Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers



2. If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

• Build driver schedules and assign trips against them

• Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered

• Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output

• Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves

• Notify drivers of schedule changes



3. If assigned to OTP Specialist

• Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after

• Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution

• Keep clients informed before they have to ask

• Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue



4. If assigned to Routing Specialist

• Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability

• Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup

• Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap

• Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete



5. If assigned to Market Associate

• Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market

• Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market

• Flag early which area is about to break



Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

• Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked

• Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off

• Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend

• Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch

• Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet

• Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area

• Bring us patterns, not just i



Requirements:



Required

• 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue

• Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you

• Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to d
 quickly and defend the call

• Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it

• Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any

• Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers

• Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned

• Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences

• Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly

• Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls



Preferred

• NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience

• Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background

• Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience

• Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding

• Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

title: ArchiCAD Draftsman for German Architecture Projects (ongoing, remote)
description:
We are a German drafting service and we are looking for an ArchiCAD draftsman to produce architectural drawings to German standards, on an ongoing basis.



This is not a one-off gig. We want to build a working relationship with one or two reliable ArchiCAD people and send every suitable ArchiCAD job their way as our order volume grows.



What we do



We prepare drawings for private clients, architects and building companies in Germany. We handle the client, the site information and the full specification. You do the drawing.



Some of our clients work in ArchiCAD themselves and want the project as an ArchiCAD file they can continue working in. That is what this post is about. A typical job: a client gives us a hand sketch, an existing plan or a DWG of a house. We turn that into a complete, dimensioned specification. You build it as a clean ArchiCAD model and produce plans, sections and elevations that look like they came out of a German architecture office.



Typical projects are detached and semi-detached houses and small apartment buildings, often for building permit applications. Scale 1:100, sometimes 1:50, sheets DIN A3 to A1.



What the work involves

- Modelling in ArchiCAD: walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors and windows as real elements

- Floor plans, sections and elevations taken from the model, never drawn separately in 2D

- Terrain levels and site plan entries when the client supplies them

- Sometimes continuing an existing ArchiCAD or DWG project from a client

- We do not need renderings or visualisations.



Deliverables for every job

- .pln, saved in the ArchiCAD version we name for the project, with clean layers and layer combinations

- .dwg, exported so that it opens cleanly in AutoCAD, with dimensions as real dimension objects

- .pdf, vector, true to scale, monochrome, with pen weights plotted



What you need



1. Your own commercial ArchiCAD license. This is a must. No educational version, no trial version, and no license that belongs to an employer or another client. If we shortlist you, we will ask for a screenshot of your license information.



2. Work entirely in metric. Metres and centimetres. If your drafting experience is in feet and inches, this job is not for you.



3. Work to German drawing conventions. They differ from Australian, US and UK practice in specific ways. The most important ones:

- Dimension lines are terminated with a 45° oblique tick, never with an arrowhead

- The decimal separator is a comma: 3,99, never 3.99

- Dimensions of one metre and more in metres with two decimals, smaller ones in centimetres; half centimetres are written as a small raised 5

- Openings are dimensioned with the width above the dimension line and the height below it

- Dimension chains run in three parallel rows per façade, from the building outwards: openings, then walls and rooms, then the overall dimension, and every chain has to close exactly

- Levels are given relative to ±0,00 at the finished floor of the ground floor

- Differentiated pen weights: 0,50 mm for cut walls, 0,35 mm for visible edges, 0,25 mm for dimension lines, 0,13 – 0,18 mm for hatching. A drawing where every line has the same weight is not acceptable.

- Hatching on cut building materials at a spacing that actually reads on the printed sheet

- Text in a font that renders German characters (ä ö ü ß) correctly



You do not need to know these conventions by heart. We supply a written brief in English that specifies them. But you need to be the kind of drafter who can follow a specification to the millimetre. That is the core of this job.



4. Build a clean model. Walls joined correctly, no duplicate elements, stories and heights set correctly, sections that match the plans. We check this.



5. Communicate in written English. You do not need to speak German. All German text that appears on the drawing, such as room names, notes and title block, is supplied as ready-to-copy strings.



6. Keep client files confidential. You sign a confidentiality agreement before you see any client files.



What you get from us



We do not send vague requests. Before you start a job you receive:

1. The written brief with every drawing convention specified

2. A dimensionally verified schematic from us, with every dimension chain already closed, a door schedule and a window schedule giving the exact position of every opening from a defined origin point, and the heights the client has given us

3. All site information and the client's files



There are no design decisions for you to make and nothing to guess. If something in our package is ambiguous, you ask and we answer. That is on us, not on you.



Pay



USD 6 – 12 per hour, depending on the quality, speed and experience you show. Paid by the hour for the time you actually work, and paid on time.



How we start



The first assignment is a small paid test task of about two hours: a small part of a house from our schematic, modelled in ArchiCAD with walls, slab and openings, delivered as PLN, DWG and PDF with one dimension chain, one room stamp and one section. Paid at your agreed rate. It tells both of us within a day whether the conventions work out.



On volume, honestly: we are a young business and growing, and ArchiCAD jobs come in less often than our AutoCAD work at the moment. We are not going to promise you a guaranteed number of hours every week, because we cannot. What we can say is that we intend to send every suitable ArchiCAD job to the same person.



Please do NOT apply if

- You do not have your own commercial ArchiCAD license

- You work primarily in feet and inches

- Your portfolio is renderings and visualisations rather than dimensioned working drawings

- You cannot show work you have drawn yourself

- You need a guaranteed full-time workload right now



A straight "this is not my kind of work" costs you nothing and we will remember you positively.



HOW TO APPLY - please read, this d
 it



1. Start your message with the word BAUANTRAG. It is German for "building permit application". It tells us you read the post rather than mass-applying. Applications without it are not read.



2. Attach one or two PDFs of ArchiCAD drawings you have drawn yourself: a dimensioned floor plan and a section or elevation of the same building. Add one screenshot of the ArchiCAD model of that project. This is by far the most important part of your application.



We will look at exactly these things in your sample:

- Do the dimension chains close, and are they complete?

- Are the pen weights differentiated, or is everything one weight?

- Is the drawing in metric?

- Do the section and elevations match the floor plan?

- Does the sheet look finished: title block, legend, north arrow, room stamps?



3. Answer these four questions, briefly:



a) Which countries' standards have you drawn to? If you have worked on German, Austrian, Swiss or other European projects, say so and say which office or client. That moves you to the front of the queue.



b) What is your hourly rate for this work, and roughly how many hours would you estimate for a two-storey house of about 150 m², modelled in ArchiCAD from our schematic, with both floor plans at 1:100, one section and four elevations on A3?



c) When can you work? Please list every day from Monday to Sunday with the hours you are usually available, in Philippine time, for example:

Monday: 9:00 – 17:00 (8 hours)

Tuesday: 18:00 – 22:00 (4 hours)

Sunday: not available

Also tell us how quickly you usually reply to messages on those days.



d) Which ArchiCAD version do you use, and is the license a commercial license in your own name? Which other CAD software do you own (AutoCAD, Allplan, Revit)? Tell us the actual versions.



4. Tell us how fast you can usually start once a project comes in.



Thank you for reading this far. We know it is a long post, and that is deliberate. We would rather have five applications from people who fit than fifty from people who do not.



Sander Marquardt

Zeichenpartner, Germany
